quote: However, the antioxidant parameters were significantly enhanced, while the MDA content was significantly reduced in the HYPO + VC group.

quote: the protein levels of Nrf2 and Keap1 increased significantly in the liver after acute hypoxia stimulation.

text_en: Acute hypoxia significantly induced liver hsp70 expression levels, and significantly reduced the expression of antioxidant-related genes such as sod and gpx, but had no significant effect on cat expression.

outcome: 热休克蛋白抑制与抗氧化酶基因上调

quote: During the experiment, the experimental fish were fed to apparent satiety at 8:30, 13:30 and 18:30.
statement: Fish were fed to apparent satiety three times daily during the experiment.

quote: The water temperature was measured every day; the fluctuation range was 29–31 °C.
statement: Water temperature fluctuated between 29 and 31 degrees Celsius during the experiment.
text_en: Water temperature fluctuated between 29 and 31 degrees Celsius during the experiment.

quote: Dissolved oxygen, ammonia nitrogen, and pH were monitored weekly, with dissolved oxygen >6.0 mg/L, total ammonia nitrogen 2.4.
statement: Dissolved oxygen was maintained above 6.0 mg/L and total ammonia nitrogen was recorded as 2.4 during monitoring.
text_en: Dissolved oxygen was maintained above 6.0 mg/L and total ammonia nitrogen was recorded as 2.4 during monitoring.

quote: The oxygen concentration of the hypoxia workstation (Ruskinn INVIVO 2 400, Beijing Longfujia Biotechnology Co., Ltd, Beijing, China) was adjusted to 2% to create a closed hypoxic environment, and the fish were moved into the hypoxia workstation for close monitoring.
statement: Fish were exposed to a closed hypoxic environment with 2% oxygen concentration using a hypoxia workstation.
text_en: Fish were exposed to a closed hypoxic environment with 2% oxygen concentration using a hypoxia workstation.

quote: Herein, the expression levels of ire1 , perk , atf6 , bip , atf4 , and chop in the liver were significantly upregulated after acute hypoxia, indicating that acute hypoxia stimulation induced the activation of hepatic ER stress in gibel carp.
statement: 急性缺氧显著上调了鲫鱼肝脏中ire1、perk、atf6、bip、atf4和chop的表达水平，表明急性缺氧刺激诱导了肝脏内质网应激的激活。
text_zh: 急性缺氧显著上调了鲫鱼肝脏中ire1、perk、atf6、bip、atf4和chop的表达水平，表明急性缺氧刺激诱导了肝脏内质网应激的激活。
text_en: Acute hypoxia significantly upregulated the expression levels of ire1, perk, atf6, bip, atf4 and chop in the liver of crucian carp, indicating that acute hypoxia stimulation induced the activation of hepatic endoplasmic reticulum stress.

quote: However, ire1 , perk , and bip genes in the liver tissue were significantly downregulated by VC supplementation.
statement: 然而，维生素C补充剂显著下调了肝组织中ire1、perk和bip基因的表达。
text_zh: 然而，维生素C补充剂显著下调了肝组织中ire1、perk和bip基因的表达。
text_en: However, vitamin C supplementation significantly downregulated the expression of ire1, perk and bip genes in liver tissue.
outcome: 内质网应激相关基因表达

quote: Therefore, VC may exert its pharmacological protective effect in the liver by inhibiting ER stress in fish.
statement: 因此，维生素C可能通过抑制鱼类内质网应激来发挥其药理学保护作用。
text_zh: 因此，维生素C可能通过抑制鱼类内质网应激来发挥其药理学保护作用。
text_en: Therefore, vitamin C may exert its pharmacological protective effect by inhibiting endoplasmic reticulum stress in fish.
outcome: 肝脏保护/内质网应激抑制

quote: In the present study, beclin1 , lc3b , and atg5 mRNA levels were significantly upregulated in the hypoxia group, indicating that the autophagy process was initiated.
statement: 在本研究中，缺氧组中beclin1、lc3b和atg5的mRNA水平显著上调，表明自噬过程被启动。
text_zh: 在本研究中，缺氧组中beclin1、lc3b和atg5的mRNA水平显著上调，表明自噬过程被启动。
text_en: In this study, the mRNA levels of beclin1, lc3b and atg5 were significantly upregulated in the hypoxia group, indicating that autophagy was initiated.

quote: Gene expression levels of proinflammatory cytokines tnf- α , il-2 , and il-6 in gibel carp liver were significantly increased in the acute hypoxia group compared with the control group.
statement: 与对照组相比，急性缺氧组银鲫肝脏中促炎细胞因子tnf-α、il-2和il-6的基因表达水平显著升高。
text_zh: 与对照组相比，急性缺氧组银鲫肝脏中促炎细胞因子tnf-α、il-2和il-6的基因表达水平显著升高。
text_en: Compared with the control group, gene expression levels of pro-inflammatory cytokines TNF-α, IL-2 and IL-6 in the liver of gibel carp were significantly increased in the acute hypoxia group.

quote: The VC treatment significantly decreased the gene expression levels of tnf- α , il-2 , il-6 , and il-12 .
statement: 维生素C处理显著降低了tnf-α、il-2、il-6和il-12的基因表达水平。
text_zh: 维生素C处理显著降低了tnf-α、il-2、il-6和il-12的基因表达水平。
text_en: Vitamin C treatment significantly reduced the gene expression levels of tnf-α, il-2, il-6 and il-12.

quote: The transcript levels of anti-inflammatory cytokines il-4 and tgf- β were inhibited by acute hypoxia.
statement: 急性缺氧抑制了抗炎细胞因子il-4和tgf-β的转录水平。
text_zh: 急性缺氧抑制了抗炎细胞因子il-4和tgf-β的转录水平。
text_en: Acute hypoxia inhibited the transcription levels of the anti-inflammatory cytokines IL-4 and TGF-β.

quote: The gene expression levels of il-4 and tgf- β were significantly increased in the VC-fed group after acute hypoxic stress.
statement: 在急性缺氧应激后，喂食维生素C组的il-4和tgf-β基因表达水平显著增加。
text_zh: 在急性缺氧应激后，喂食维生素C组的il-4和tgf-β基因表达水平显著增加。
text_en: After acute hypoxia stress, the expression levels of il-4 and tgf-β genes increased significantly in the group fed vitamin C.

quote: The mRNA levels of il-1 β and i кb α were unaltered after the hypoxia treatment in all of the groups.
statement: 在所有组别中，缺氧处理后il-1β和iκbα的mRNA水平未发生改变。
text_zh: 在所有组别中，缺氧处理后il-1β和iκbα的mRNA水平未发生改变。
text_en: In all groups, mRNA levels of il-1β and iκbα did not change after hypoxia treatment.

quote: The expression levels of proapoptotic genes bax and casp3 , casp9 and ero1α were significantly induced by hypoxia.
statement: 急性缺氧显著诱导了促凋亡基因bax、casp3、casp9和ero1α的表达水平。
text_zh: 急性缺氧显著诱导了促凋亡基因bax、casp3、casp9和ero1α的表达水平。
text_en: Acute hypoxia significantly induced the expression levels of pro-apoptotic genes bax, casp3, casp9 and ero1α.

quote: Acute hypoxia induced the activities of Casp 3 and Casp 9 compared with the control group.
statement: 与对照组相比，急性缺氧诱导了肝脏中Casp 3和Casp 9活性的升高。
text_zh: 与对照组相比，急性缺氧诱导了肝脏中Casp 3和Casp 9活性的升高。
text_en: Compared with the control group, acute hypoxia induced increased activities of Casp 3 and Casp 9 in the liver.

quote: However, VC treatment significantly decreased the activities of Casp 3 and Casp 9 in the liver of gibel carp.
statement: 然而，维生素C处理显著降低了鲫鱼肝脏中Casp 3和Casp 9的活性。
text_zh: 然而，维生素C处理显著降低了鲫鱼肝脏中Casp 3和Casp 9的活性。
text_en: However, vitamin C treatment significantly reduced the activity of Casp 3 and Casp 9 in the liver of crucian carp.

quote: Apoptosis signals were increased significantly after acute hypoxia stimulation, and these were decreased in fish fed with VC diet after hypoxia.
statement: 急性缺氧刺激后凋亡信号显著增加，而在缺氧后喂食含维生素C饲料的鱼中这些信号减少。
text_zh: 急性缺氧刺激后凋亡信号显著增加，而在缺氧后喂食含维生素C饲料的鱼中这些信号减少。
text_en: Apoptotic signals significantly increased after acute hypoxia stimulation, while these signals decreased in fish fed with VC diet after hypoxia.

quote: the expression levels of GRP78 protein in gibel carp liver were significantly increased after acute hypoxia stimulation
statement: 急性缺氧刺激显著增加了银鲫肝脏中GRP78蛋白的表达水平。
text_zh: 急性缺氧刺激显著增加了银鲫肝脏中GRP78蛋白的表达水平。
text_en: Acute hypoxia stimulation significantly increased the expression level of GRP78 protein in the liver of gibel carp.

quote: However, the GRP78 protein levels were significantly decreased in fish fed the VC diet.
statement: 饲喂维生素C饲料的鱼GRP78蛋白水平显著降低。
text_zh: 饲喂维生素C饲料的鱼GRP78蛋白水平显著降低。
text_en: The GRP78 protein levels in fish fed vitamin C feed were significantly reduced.

quote: The transcript levels of ire1 , perk , atf6, bip , atf6, and chop were significantly higher in the hypoxia group compared with the control group
statement: 与对照组相比，缺氧组中ire1、perk、atf6、bip和chop的转录水平显著升高。
text_zh: 与对照组相比，缺氧组中ire1、perk、atf6、bip和chop的转录水平显著升高。
text_en: Compared with the control group, the transcription levels of ire1, perk, atf6, bip and chop were significantly increased in the hypoxia group.
outcome: 内质网应激相关基因表达

quote: However, xbp1 and eif2a mRNA levels were not affected by hypoxic stress.
statement: xbp1和eif2a的mRNA水平未受缺氧应激影响。
text_zh: xbp1和eif2a的mRNA水平未受缺氧应激影响。
text_en: The mRNA levels of xbp1 and eif2a were not affected by hypoxia stress.
outcome: 内质网应激相关基因表达

quote: In the HYPO + VC group, the expression of the ER stress-related GRP78 protein and ire1 , perk , and bip genes was significantly decreased.
statement: 在HYPO + VC组中，内质网应激相关的GRP78蛋白以及ire1、perk和bip基因的表达显著降低。
text_zh: 在HYPO + VC组中，内质网应激相关的GRP78蛋白以及ire1、perk和bip基因的表达显著降低。
text_en: In the HYPO + VC group, the expression of the endoplasmic reticulum stress-related GRP78 protein and the ire1, perk, and bip genes was significantly reduced.

quote: There were no significant differences in atf4 , atf6 , or chop mRNA levels.
statement: atf4、atf6或chop的mRNA水平无显著差异。
text_zh: atf4、atf6或chop的mRNA水平无显著差异。
text_en: There was no significant difference in the mRNA levels of atf4, atf6 or chop.
outcome: 内质网应激相关基因表达

quote: VC protected fish from acute hypoxia injury by enhancing Nrf2/Keap1 signaling and downregulating the level of HIF-1α protein, thereby leading to inhibition of oxidative stress, inflammation, and apoptosis.
statement: 维生素C通过增强Nrf2/Keap1信号传导和下调HIF-1α蛋白水平，从而抑制氧化应激、炎症和细胞凋亡，保护鱼类免受急性缺氧损伤。
text_zh: 维生素C通过增强Nrf2/Keap1信号传导和下调HIF-1α蛋白水平，从而抑制氧化应激、炎症和细胞凋亡，保护鱼类免受急性缺氧损伤。
text_en: Vitamin C protects fish from acute hypoxia injury by inhibiting oxidative stress, inflammation and apoptosis through enhancing Nrf2/Keap1 signaling and downregulating HIF-1α protein levels.
outcome: 急性缺氧引起的氧化损伤、炎症和细胞凋亡

quote: This study provides new evidence for the hypothesis that VC supplementation can effectively alleviate oxidative stress and inflammation induced by acute hypoxia in fish.
statement: 本研究为维生素C补充剂能有效缓解鱼类急性缺氧诱导的氧化应激和炎症这一假设提供了新的证据。
text_zh: 本研究为维生素C补充剂能有效缓解鱼类急性缺氧诱导的氧化应激和炎症这一假设提供了新的证据。
text_en: This study provides new evidence for the hypothesis that vitamin C supplementation can effectively alleviate oxidative stress and inflammation induced by acute hypoxia in fish.
outcome: 急性缺氧诱导的氧化应激和炎症

quote: In the present study, the expression levels of pro-inflammatory genes tnf-α , il-2 , and il-6 were upregulated in the hypoxia group, while the expression levels of anti-inflammatory genes il-4 and tgf-β were downregulated, suggesting that acute hypoxia stimulated an inflammatory response in gibel carp.
statement: 在本研究中，缺氧组促炎基因tnf-α、il-2和il-6的表达水平上调，而抗炎基因il-4和tgf-β的表达水平下调，表明急性缺氧刺激了鲫鱼的炎症反应。
text_zh: 在本研究中，缺氧组促炎基因tnf-α、il-2和il-6的表达水平上调，而抗炎基因il-4和tgf-β的表达水平下调，表明急性缺氧刺激了鲫鱼的炎症反应。
text_en: In this study, the expression levels of pro-inflammatory genes tnf-α, il-2 and il-6 were upregulated in the hypoxia group, while the expression levels of anti-inflammatory genes il-4 and tgf-β were downregulated, indicating that acute hypoxia stimulated the inflammatory response in crucian carp.

quote: Upregulated expression of tnf-α , il-2 , il-6 , and il-12 and downregulated expression of anti-inflammatory genes il-4 and tgf-β induced by VC suggested that VC attenuated the expression of proinflammatory factors [ 44 ].
statement: VC处理导致的促炎因子上调和抗炎基因下调表明VC减弱了促炎因子的表达。
text_zh: VC处理导致的促炎因子上调和抗炎基因下调表明VC减弱了促炎因子的表达。
text_en: The upregulation of pro-inflammatory factors and downregulation of anti-inflammatory genes caused by VC treatment indicate that VC attenuated the expression of pro-inflammatory factors.

quote: Thus, oxidative stress, inflammation, and apoptosis were attenuated by VC via the Nrf2/Keap1 pathway in gibel carp.
statement: 在银鲫中，VC通过Nrf2/Keap1通路减轻了氧化应激、炎症和细胞凋亡。
text_zh: 在银鲫中，VC通过Nrf2/Keap1通路减轻了氧化应激、炎症和细胞凋亡。
text_en: In silver crucian carp, VC alleviated oxidative stress, inflammation, and apoptosis via the Nrf2/Keap1 pathway.
outcome: 氧化应激、炎症和细胞凋亡

quote: In the present study, VC treatment reduced the expression of GRP78, a marker protein of ER stress induced by acute hypoxia.
statement: 本研究中，VC处理降低了由急性缺氧诱导的内质网应激标志蛋白GRP78的表达。
text_zh: 本研究中，VC处理降低了由急性缺氧诱导的内质网应激标志蛋白GRP78的表达。
text_en: In this study, VC treatment reduced the expression of the endoplasmic reticulum stress marker protein GRP78 induced by acute hypoxia.

quote: Ascorbic acid regulates the immunity, anti-oxidation and apoptosis in abalone Haliotis discus hannai Ino.
statement: 抗坏血酸调节鲍鱼的免疫、抗氧化和细胞凋亡。
text_zh: 抗坏血酸调节鲍鱼的免疫、抗氧化和细胞凋亡。
text_en: Ascorbic acid regulates immunity, antioxidant activity, and apoptosis in abalone.

quote: Effects of dietary carbohydrate and lipid concentrations on growth performance, feed utilization, glucose, and lipid metabolism in two strains of gibel carp.
statement: 日粮碳水化合物和脂质浓度对两种异育银鲫的生长性能、饲料利用率、葡萄糖和脂质代谢有影响。
text_zh: 日粮碳水化合物和脂质浓度对两种异育银鲫的生长性能、饲料利用率、葡萄糖和脂质代谢有影响。
text_en: Dietary carbohydrate and lipid concentrations affect the growth performance, feed utilization, glucose and lipid metabolism of two gibel carp.
intervention: Iso-nitrogenous diets with different carbohydrate and lipid
intervention_record: 不同碳水脂质等氮日粮

quote: High dietary vitamin C affects growth, non-specific immune responses and disease resistance in asian catfish, Clarias batrachus.
statement: 高剂量日粮维生素C影响亚洲鲶鱼的生长、非特异性免疫反应和抗病力。
text_zh: 高剂量日粮维生素C影响亚洲鲶鱼的生长、非特异性免疫反应和抗病力。
text_en: High-dose dietary vitamin C affects the growth, non-specific immune response and disease resistance of Asian catfish.

quote: Effects of emodin and vitamin C on growth performance, biochemical parameters and two HSP70s mRNA expression of Wuchang bream (Megalobrama amblycephala Yih) under high temperature stress.
statement: 大黄素和维生素C在高温胁迫下对武昌鱼生长性能、生化参数及两种HSP70 mRNA表达的影响。
text_zh: 大黄素和维生素C在高温胁迫下对武昌鱼生长性能、生化参数及两种HSP70 mRNA表达的影响。
text_en: Effects of emodin and vitamin C on growth performance, biochemical parameters, and the expression of two HSP70 mRNAs in Wuchang bream under high-temperature stress.
outcome: 高温胁迫下的生理指标

quote: MDA was significantly upregulated by hypoxia in gibel carp.
statement: 缺氧导致鲫鱼MDA显著上调。
text_zh: 缺氧导致鲫鱼MDA显著上调。
text_en: Hypoxia caused a significant upregulation of MDA in crucian carp.

quote: The MDA content in the liver tissue was downregulated in VC-fed fish, indicating that VC plays a potential protective role in alleviating acute hypoxia-induced oxidative stress.
statement: 喂食VC的鱼肝脏中MDA含量下调，表明VC在缓解急性缺氧诱导的氧化应激方面具有潜在保护作用。
text_zh: 喂食VC的鱼肝脏中MDA含量下调，表明VC在缓解急性缺氧诱导的氧化应激方面具有潜在保护作用。
text_en: MDA content in the livers of fish fed VC was downregulated, indicating that VC has a potential protective effect in alleviating acute hypoxia-induced oxidative stress.

quote: The antioxidant capacity was improved through Nrf2/Keap1 signaling by a VC-supplemented diet in abalone [ 21 ].
statement: 在鲍鱼中，通过VC补充饮食经由Nrf2/Keap1信号通路改善了抗氧化能力。
text_zh: 在鲍鱼中，通过VC补充饮食经由Nrf2/Keap1信号通路改善了抗氧化能力。
text_en: In abalone, a VC-supplemented diet improved antioxidant capacity via the Nrf2/Keap1 signaling pathway.

quote: In the present study, the Nrf2/Keap1 pathway was activated by acute hypoxia, as indicated by increased protein levels of Nrf2.
statement: 在本研究中，急性缺氧激活了Nrf2/Keap1通路，表现为Nrf2蛋白水平升高。
text_zh: 在本研究中，急性缺氧激活了Nrf2/Keap1通路，表现为Nrf2蛋白水平升高。
text_en: In this study, acute hypoxia activated the Nrf2/Keap1 pathway, as indicated by elevated Nrf2 protein levels.

quote: Since increased protein expression of Nrf2 and decreased protein expression of Keap1 were found in VC-supplemented group, this indicated that VC was involved in the Nrf2/Keap1 pathway regulation of hypoxia.
statement: 由于在VC补充组中发现Nrf2蛋白表达增加和Keap1蛋白表达减少，这表明VC参与了缺氧的Nrf2/Keap1通路调节。
text_zh: 由于在VC补充组中发现Nrf2蛋白表达增加和Keap1蛋白表达减少，这表明VC参与了缺氧的Nrf2/Keap1通路调节。
text_en: The increased Nrf2 protein expression and decreased Keap1 protein expression found in the VC-supplemented group indicate that VC is involved in the regulation of the Nrf2/Keap1 pathway under hypoxia.

quote: In biochemical tests, the cortisol level is used as a characteristic index of fish stress intensity.
statement: 在生化测试中，皮质醇水平被用作鱼类应激强度的特征指标。
text_zh: 在生化测试中，皮质醇水平被用作鱼类应激强度的特征指标。
text_en: In biochemical tests, cortisol levels are used as a characteristic indicator of stress intensity in fish.

quote: The levels of cortisol in the hypoxia group were significantly increased, suggesting that hypoxia could induce a severe stress response in gibel carp.
statement: 缺氧组皮质醇水平显著升高，表明缺氧可诱导银鲫产生严重的应激反应。
text_zh: 缺氧组皮质醇水平显著升高，表明缺氧可诱导银鲫产生严重的应激反应。
text_en: Cortisol levels in the hypoxia group increased significantly, indicating that hypoxia can induce a severe stress response in gibel carp.

quote: However, in the treatment group fed the VC supplemented diet, the levels of glucose, lactate, and cortisol in the plasma were significantly decreased, indicating that VC alleviated the hypoxic stimulation of gibel carp.
statement: 然而，在喂食添加维生素C饲料的处理组中，血浆中的葡萄糖、乳酸和皮质醇水平显著降低，表明维生素C缓解了缺氧对银鲫的刺激。
text_zh: 然而，在喂食添加维生素C饲料的处理组中，血浆中的葡萄糖、乳酸和皮质醇水平显著降低，表明维生素C缓解了缺氧对银鲫的刺激。
text_en: However, in the treatment group fed a vitamin C-supplemented diet, plasma glucose, lactate, and cortisol levels were significantly reduced, indicating that vitamin C alleviated the stress of hypoxia on silver crucian carp.

quote: In the present study, HIF-1α protein expression in the liver was significantly upregulated after acute hypoxic stimulation.
statement: 在本研究中，急性缺氧刺激后肝脏中HIF-1α蛋白表达显著上调。
text_zh: 在本研究中，急性缺氧刺激后肝脏中HIF-1α蛋白表达显著上调。
text_en: In this study, HIF-1α protein expression in the liver was significantly upregulated after acute hypoxic stimulation.

quote: Interestingly, VC supplementation alleviated the induction of HIF-1α protein expression by hypoxia, indicating a decreased response of fish to hypoxic stress.
statement: 有趣的是，补充维生素C缓解了缺氧诱导的HIF-1α蛋白表达，表明鱼类对缺氧应激的反应减弱。
text_zh: 有趣的是，补充维生素C缓解了缺氧诱导的HIF-1α蛋白表达，表明鱼类对缺氧应激的反应减弱。
text_en: Interestingly, vitamin C supplementation alleviated hypoxia-induced HIF-1α protein expression, indicating a reduced response to hypoxic stress in fish.

quote: CAT and SOD activities were significantly downregulated after 12 h of acute hypoxia in the liver of largemouth bass (Micropterus salmoides) [ 33 ].
statement: 大口黑鲈肝脏中过氧化氢酶（CAT）和超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）活性在急性缺氧12小时后显著下调。
text_zh: 大口黑鲈肝脏中过氧化氢酶（CAT）和超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）活性在急性缺氧12小时后显著下调。
text_en: Catalase (CAT) and superoxide dismutase (SOD) activities in the liver of largemouth bass were significantly downregulated after 12 hours of acute hypoxia.

quote: In the present study, compared with the control group, the activities of CAT, SOD, and GPx in the liver of gibel carp in the hypoxia group were downregulated, together with decreased T-AOC, implying that hypoxia leads to an excessive accumulation of ROS and the body possible severe oxidative damage.
statement: 在本研究中，与对照组相比，缺氧组银鲫肝脏中CAT、SOD和GPx的活性下调，总抗氧化能力（T-AOC）也降低，这意味着缺氧导致ROS过度积累，机体可能发生严重的氧化损伤。
text_zh: 在本研究中，与对照组相比，缺氧组银鲫肝脏中CAT、SOD和GPx的活性下调，总抗氧化能力（T-AOC）也降低，这意味着缺氧导致ROS过度积累，机体可能发生严重的氧化损伤。
text_en: In this study, compared with the control group, the activities of CAT, SOD and GPx in the liver of gibel carp (Carassius gibelio) in the hypoxia group were downregulated, and the total antioxidant capacity (T-AOC) also decreased, which means that hypoxia led to excessive accumulation of ROS, and severe oxidative damage may have occurred in the body.

quote: Coriander (Coriandrum sativum) is considered a natural chelator, able to promote the liver antioxidant system [13], bind and immobilize cadmium chloride in the liver and kidneys [14-16] and reduce the toxic accumulation of cadmium in the tissues of the rainbow trout Oncorhynchus mykiss [14].
statement: 芫荽被认为是一种天然螯合剂，能够促进肝脏抗氧化系统，结合并固定肝肾中的氯化镉，并减少虹鳟组织中镉的毒性积累。
text_zh: 芫荽被认为是一种天然螯合剂，能够促进肝脏抗氧化系统，结合并固定肝肾中的氯化镉，并减少虹鳟组织中镉的毒性积累。
text_en: Coriander is considered a natural chelator, capable of promoting the hepatic antioxidant system, binding and immobilizing cadmium chloride in the liver and kidneys, and reducing the toxic accumulation of cadmium in rainbow trout tissues.

quote: More recently, it has been found that it ensure an optimal growth and health regardless of whether rearing water is contaminated with heavy metals in Beluga fed a diet containing coriander [18, 19].
statement: 最近发现，在喂食含有芫荽饲料的白鲟中，无论养殖水是否受重金属污染，它都能确保最佳生长和健康。
text_zh: 最近发现，在喂食含有芫荽饲料的白鲟中，无论养殖水是否受重金属污染，它都能确保最佳生长和健康。
text_en: It has recently been found that in beluga sturgeon fed with coriander-containing feed, optimal growth and health are ensured regardless of whether the aquaculture water is contaminated with heavy metals.

quote: Plasma lactic acid (LD) and total anti-oxidant capacity (T-AOC), superoxide dismutase (SOD), catalase (CAT), reduced glutathione (GSH), glutathione peroxidase (GPX), and the concentration of malondialdehyde (MDA) were determined using commercial kits (Nanjing Jiancheng Bioengineering Institute, Catalog: A019-2-1, A015-2, A001-3-2, A007-1-1, A006-2-1, and A005-1-2 and A003-1-2).
statement: 血浆乳酸(LD)、总抗氧化能力(T-AOC)、超氧化物歧化酶(SOD)、过氧化氢酶(CAT)、还原型谷胱甘肽(GSH)、谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶(GPX)和丙二醛(MDA)浓度使用商业试剂盒测定。
text_zh: 血浆乳酸(LD)、总抗氧化能力(T-AOC)、超氧化物歧化酶(SOD)、过氧化氢酶(CAT)、还原型谷胱甘肽(GSH)、谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶(GPX)和丙二醛(MDA)浓度使用商业试剂盒测定。
text_en: The concentrations of plasma lactate (LD), total antioxidant capacity (T-AOC), superoxide dismutase (SOD), catalase (CAT), reduced glutathione (GSH), glutathione peroxidase (GPX), and malondialdehyde (MDA) were determined using commercial kits.

quote: Combined exposure to hypoxia and ammonia aggravated biological effects on glucose metabolism, oxidative stress, inflammation and apoptosis in largemouth bass (Micropterus salmoides)
statement: 联合暴露于低氧和氨会加剧大口黑鲈的葡萄糖代谢、氧化应激、炎症和细胞凋亡等生物学效应。
text_zh: 联合暴露于低氧和氨会加剧大口黑鲈的葡萄糖代谢、氧化应激、炎症和细胞凋亡等生物学效应。
text_en: Combined exposure to hypoxia and ammonia exacerbates biological effects such as glucose metabolism, oxidative stress, inflammation, and apoptosis in largemouth bass.
outcome: 生理健康（氧化应激、炎症、细胞凋亡）

quote: Hyperoxia results in transient oxidative stress and an adaptive response by antioxidant enzymes in goldfish tissues.
statement: 高氧导致金鱼组织中出现短暂的氧化应激以及抗氧化酶的适应性反应。
text_zh: 高氧导致金鱼组织中出现短暂的氧化应激以及抗氧化酶的适应性反应。
text_en: High oxygen causes transient oxidative stress and an adaptive response of antioxidant enzymes in goldfish tissues.
outcome: 氧化应激与抗氧化反应

quote: Effect of dietary vitamin C on the growth performance, antioxidant ability and innate immunity of juvenile yellow catfish (Pelteobagrus fulvidracoRichardson)
statement: 日粮维生素C对黄颡鱼幼鱼生长性能、抗氧化能力和先天免疫的影响。
text_zh: 日粮维生素C对黄颡鱼幼鱼生长性能、抗氧化能力和先天免疫的影响。
text_en: Effects of dietary vitamin C on growth performance, antioxidant capacity, and innate immunity of juvenile yellow catfish.
outcome: 生长性能、抗氧化能力、先天免疫

quote: The liver of individuals subjected to chronic lead poisoning loses its normal architecture; the disorganized appearance of the hepatocyte cords can be observed on the sections made on this organ, the hepatocytes are hypertrophic, with clear, vacuolated cytoplasm (hepatocellular necrosis is considered a biomarker for the evaluation of chronic poisoning in fish) and a pyknotic nucleus (morphology characteristic of cell death); pericentrolobular necrosis with hypertrophies of the sinusoidal capillaries is frequently manifested in them
statement: 慢性铅中毒导致鱼类肝脏失去正常结构，表现为肝细胞索紊乱、肝细胞肥大、胞质空泡化、核固缩以及中心小叶周围坏死和窦状毛细血管肥大。
text_zh: 慢性铅中毒导致鱼类肝脏失去正常结构，表现为肝细胞索紊乱、肝细胞肥大、胞质空泡化、核固缩以及中心小叶周围坏死和窦状毛细血管肥大。
text_en: Chronic lead poisoning causes fish livers to lose their normal structure, manifested as disordered hepatic cell cords, hepatocyte hypertrophy, cytoplasmic vacuolization, nuclear pyknosis, and necrosis around the central lobule with sinusoidal capillary hypertrophy.

quote: The histopathological changes recorded in Pb-intoxicated individuals are absent in the case of those who additionally received freeze-dried coriander in their daily diet.
statement: 在每日饮食中额外添加冻干香菜的受试个体中，未观察到铅中毒个体所记录的病理组织学变化。
text_zh: 在每日饮食中额外添加冻干香菜的受试个体中，未观察到铅中毒个体所记录的病理组织学变化。
text_en: In subjects receiving additional freeze-dried cilantro in their daily diet, no histopathological changes recorded in lead-poisoned individuals were observed.

quote: Ordered hepatocyte cords are observed in them (Figure 13). Normal-appearing sinusoidal capillaries lie between cords of hepatocytes.
statement: 接受冻干香菜处理的个体肝脏显示出有序的肝细胞索和外观正常的窦状毛细血管。
text_zh: 接受冻干香菜处理的个体肝脏显示出有序的肝细胞索和外观正常的窦状毛细血管。
text_en: Individuals receiving freeze-dried coriander treatment showed livers with organized hepatic cords and sinusoidal capillaries of normal appearance.

quote: The changes of autophagy-related genes, including atg12 , p62 , beclin1 , lc3b , and atg5 , in gibel carp liver after acute hypoxia stimulation are presented in Figure 7 A.
statement: 急性缺氧刺激后，异育银鲫肝脏中自噬相关基因（包括atg12、p62、beclin1、lc3b和atg5）的表达发生变化。
text_zh: 急性缺氧刺激后，异育银鲫肝脏中自噬相关基因（包括atg12、p62、beclin1、lc3b和atg5）的表达发生变化。
text_en: After acute hypoxia stimulation, the expression of autophagy-related genes (including atg12, p62, beclin1, lc3b and atg5) in the liver of allogynogenetic gibel carp changed.

quote: In the liver, the expression levels of beclin1 , l c3b , and atg5 were significantly increased after the acute hypoxia stimulation compared with the control group.
statement: 与对照组相比，急性缺氧刺激后肝脏中beclin1、lc3b和atg5的表达水平显著升高。
text_zh: 与对照组相比，急性缺氧刺激后肝脏中beclin1、lc3b和atg5的表达水平显著升高。
text_en: Compared with the control group, the expression levels of beclin1, lc3b and atg5 in the liver were significantly increased after acute hypoxia stimulation.

quote: The gene expression of bcl2 was decreased significantly after acute hypoxia.
statement: 急性缺氧后，抗凋亡基因bcl2的表达显著降低。
text_zh: 急性缺氧后，抗凋亡基因bcl2的表达显著降低。
text_en: After acute hypoxia, the expression of the anti-apoptotic gene bcl2 significantly decreased.

quote: slight epithelial hypertrophies are also present (Figure 5 and Figure 6). The morphological aspects observed in these specimens suggest the presence of a slightly affected respiratory barrier, a consequence of epithelial cell hyperplasia.
statement: 同时也存在轻微的上皮增生。观察到的形态学特征表明呼吸屏障受到轻微影响，这是上皮细胞增生的结果。
text_zh: 同时也存在轻微的上皮增生。观察到的形态学特征表明呼吸屏障受到轻微影响，这是上皮细胞增生的结果。
text_en: There is also slight epithelial hyperplasia. The observed morphological characteristics indicate that the respiratory barrier is slightly affected, which is a result of epithelial cell hyperplasia.

quote: The intestinal mucosa of Pb-intoxicated individuals shows wide looking villi, reduced in height (Figure 7). Villous territories with altered epithelium are also evident, up to the disappearance of cells and microvilli. Leukocyte infiltrative cells are present in the chorion (Figure 8).
statement: 铅中毒个体的肠黏膜显示绒毛变宽且高度降低，出现上皮改变区域甚至细胞和微绒毛消失，固有层中存在白细胞浸润细胞。
text_zh: 铅中毒个体的肠黏膜显示绒毛变宽且高度降低，出现上皮改变区域甚至细胞和微绒毛消失，固有层中存在白细胞浸润细胞。
text_en: The intestinal mucosa of individuals with lead poisoning shows widened villi and reduced height, areas of epithelial changes or even loss of cells and microvilli, and leukocyte infiltration in the lamina propria.

quote: The intestinal mucosa shoes high villi, with a rectangular and triangular appearance in individuals of the LE2 group. The intestinal epithelium is very little affected, observing the presence of slight epithelial detachments at the top of villi (Figure 9).
statement: LE2组个体的肠黏膜显示高绒毛，呈矩形和三角形外观；肠上皮受影响极小，仅观察到绒毛顶部有轻微的上皮脱落。
text_zh: LE2组个体的肠黏膜显示高绒毛，呈矩形和三角形外观；肠上皮受影响极小，仅观察到绒毛顶部有轻微的上皮脱落。
text_en: The intestinal mucosa of individuals in the LE2 group showed high villi with a rectangular and triangular appearance; the intestinal epithelium was minimally affected, with only slight epithelial shedding observed at the tips of the villi.

quote: 90 Prussian carps, with weighing between 10 and 12 g were divided according to the following treatments for 21 days: C (without treatment), E1 (75 ppm Pb into water), E2 (75 ppm Pb into water+2% lyophilized coriander leaves in feed).
statement: 将90条体重10-12克的普鲁士鲤鱼分为对照组、铅暴露组和铅暴露加饲料中添加2%冻干香菜叶组，处理21天。
text_zh: 将90条体重10-12克的普鲁士鲤鱼分为对照组、铅暴露组和铅暴露加饲料中添加2%冻干香菜叶组，处理21天。

quote: In the present study, the microscopic analysis of the sections made on the gill tissue of the lead-intoxicated specimens, reveals the disorganization of the architecture of the gill lamellae: hypertrophic lamellar epithelium cells, with vacuolated cytoplasm; alteration of the connective structure in the lamellar axis; the fusion of the gill lamellae (Figure 1).
statement: 对铅中毒样本鳃组织的显微分析显示鳃小片结构紊乱：上皮细胞肥大伴胞质空泡化；轴突结缔组织改变；鳃小片融合。
text_zh: 对铅中毒样本鳃组织的显微分析显示鳃小片结构紊乱：上皮细胞肥大伴胞质空泡化；轴突结缔组织改变；鳃小片融合。
text_en: Microscopic analysis of gill tissue from lead-poisoned samples showed disorganized secondary lamellae structure: epithelial cell hypertrophy with cytoplasmic vacuolization; changes in the axial connective tissue; and fusion of secondary lamellae.

quote: Moreover, in figure 2, massive epithelial and connective degenerations appear, with the shortening to the point of destruction of the secondary gill lamellae; vascular congestion.
statement: 此外，观察到大量上皮和结缔组织变性，次级鳃小片缩短直至破坏，以及血管充血。
text_zh: 此外，观察到大量上皮和结缔组织变性，次级鳃小片缩短直至破坏，以及血管充血。
text_en: In addition, extensive degeneration of epithelial and connective tissue, shortening of secondary lamellae up to destruction, and vascular congestion were observed.

quote: In the individuals of the group that received additional lyophilized coriander in a proportion of 2%, the secondary gill lamellae, although thin, retain their uniform appearance (Figure 3 and Figure 4), being well individualized;
statement: 在额外摄入2%比例冻干香菜的个体中，次级鳃小片虽然变薄，但保持均匀外观且界限分明。
text_zh: 在额外摄入2%比例冻干香菜的个体中，次级鳃小片虽然变薄，但保持均匀外观且界限分明。
text_en: In individuals with an additional intake of 2% freeze-dried coriander, the secondary lamellae became thinner but maintained a uniform appearance and distinct boundaries.

quote: Our study aimed to highlight the histological alterations of some tissue of Prussian carp’s specimens, subjected to sub lethal Pb intoxication with and without coriander dietary supplementation.
statement: 研究旨在阐明普鲁士鲤鱼在亚致死铅中毒条件下，有无香菜膳食补充的组织学改变。
text_zh: 研究旨在阐明普鲁士鲤鱼在亚致死铅中毒条件下，有无香菜膳食补充的组织学改变。
text_en: The study aimed to elucidate histological changes in common carp under sublethal lead poisoning conditions, with and without coriander dietary supplementation.

quote: severe histological alterations in experimental Pb-poisoned group;
statement: 实验性铅中毒组出现严重的组织学改变。
text_zh: 实验性铅中毒组出现严重的组织学改变。
text_en: Severe histological changes occurred in the experimental lead poisoning group.

quote: coriander lyophilisate has been shown to be an excellent chelator on liver tissue and is largely able to attenuate the toxic effects of lead in the kidneys, intestine and gill.
statement: 香菜冻干粉被证明是肝脏组织的优良螯合剂，并能很大程度上减轻铅对肾脏、肠道和鳃的毒性作用。
text_zh: 香菜冻干粉被证明是肝脏组织的优良螯合剂，并能很大程度上减轻铅对肾脏、肠道和鳃的毒性作用。
text_en: Coriander lyophilisate was proven to be a good chelator for liver tissue and could largely reduce the toxic effects of lead on the kidney, intestine, and gills.

quote: CAT and GPx activities in the brain were induced by hypoxia in common carp (Cyprinus carpio); however, no significant difference in CAT activity in the liver or muscle was found, and GPx activity was significantly downregulated after hypoxia treatment [ 35 ].
statement: 普通鲤鱼脑中CAT和GPx活性受低氧诱导，但肝脏或肌肉中CAT活性无显著差异，且低氧处理后GPx活性显著下调。
text_zh: 普通鲤鱼脑中CAT和GPx活性受低氧诱导，但肝脏或肌肉中CAT活性无显著差异，且低氧处理后GPx活性显著下调。
text_en: CAT and GPx activity in the brain of common carp are induced by hypoxia, but there is no significant difference in CAT activity in the liver or muscle, and GPx activity is significantly downregulated after hypoxia treatment.
outcome: 组织特异性抗氧化反应

quote: In the present study, oxidative stress was effectively inhibited by VC, consistent with previous reports [ 37 , 38 ].
statement: 在本研究中，维生素C有效抑制了氧化应激，这与之前的报道一致。
text_zh: 在本研究中，维生素C有效抑制了氧化应激，这与之前的报道一致。
text_en: In this study, vitamin C effectively inhibited oxidative stress, which is consistent with previous reports.

quote: The increases of ROS and oxidative stress are positively correlated with hypoxia, both of which are considered to be the main etiological factors leading to body dysfunction and damage and are important parts of the series of events leading to proinflammatory mediators and cell apoptosis.
statement: ROS和氧化应激的增加与低氧呈正相关，二者均被认为是导致机体功能障碍和损伤的主要病因因素，也是导致促炎介质和细胞凋亡事件系列的重要组成部分。
text_zh: ROS和氧化应激的增加与低氧呈正相关，二者均被认为是导致机体功能障碍和损伤的主要病因因素，也是导致促炎介质和细胞凋亡事件系列的重要组成部分。
text_en: The increase in ROS and oxidative stress is positively correlated with hypoxia; both are considered major etiological factors leading to organism dysfunction and injury, and are also important components of the series of pro-inflammatory mediators and apoptosis events.

quote: Hypoxia causes a massive accumulation of ROS that directly or indirectly oxidizes or damages DNA, proteins, and lipids; induces the formation of lipid peroxidation; and damages cell membranes [ 39 ].
statement: 低氧导致大量ROS积累，直接或间接氧化或损伤DNA、蛋白质和脂质；诱导脂质过氧化形成；并损伤细胞膜。
text_zh: 低氧导致大量ROS积累，直接或间接氧化或损伤DNA、蛋白质和脂质；诱导脂质过氧化形成；并损伤细胞膜。
text_en: Hypoxia leads to the accumulation of large amounts of ROS, which directly or indirectly oxidize or damage DNA, proteins and lipids; induce lipid peroxidation formation; and damage cell membranes.

quote: Lipid peroxidation was the most sensitive indicator respond to hypoxia in goldfish [ 35 ].
statement: 脂质过氧化是金鱼对低氧反应最敏感的指标。
text_zh: 脂质过氧化是金鱼对低氧反应最敏感的指标。
text_en: Lipid peroxidation is the most sensitive indicator of the response to hypoxia in goldfish.

quote: MDA concentration was increased in largemouth bass after 24 h of acute hypoxia exposure [ 33 ].
statement: 大口黑鲈在急性低氧暴露24小时后MDA浓度增加。
text_zh: 大口黑鲈在急性低氧暴露24小时后MDA浓度增加。
text_en: MDA concentration increased in largemouth bass after 24 hours of acute hypoxia exposure.

quote: Vitamin C is extremely critical to maintaining normal growth and the antistress ability of fish.
statement: 维生素C对于维持鱼类的正常生长和抗应激能力至关重要。
text_zh: 维生素C对于维持鱼类的正常生长和抗应激能力至关重要。
text_en: Vitamin C is essential for maintaining normal growth and stress resistance in fish.

quote: VC participates in a variety of physiological processes in the body, such as growth, development, and stress response, and it can protect the important functions of the immune system from oxidative damage.
statement: 维生素C参与体内多种生理过程，如生长、发育和应激反应，并能保护免疫系统的重要功能免受氧化损伤。
text_zh: 维生素C参与体内多种生理过程，如生长、发育和应激反应，并能保护免疫系统的重要功能免受氧化损伤。
text_en: Vitamin C participates in various physiological processes in the body, such as growth, development, and stress response, and can protect important functions of the immune system from oxidative damage.

quote: High doses of VC significantly improved the growth performance of Asian catfish (Clarias batrachus) and Wuchang bream (Megalobrama amblycephala)
statement: 高剂量维生素C显著改善了亚洲鲶鱼（Clarias batrachus）和武昌鱼（Megalobrama amblycephala）的生长性能。
text_zh: 高剂量维生素C显著改善了亚洲鲶鱼（Clarias batrachus）和武昌鱼（Megalobrama amblycephala）的生长性能。
text_en: High-dose vitamin C significantly improved the growth performance of Asian catfish (Clarias batrachus) and blunt snout bream (Megalobrama amblycephala).

quote: a higher specific growth rate was found in fish fed the VC diet, indicating that VC improves the growth of gibel carp.
statement: 喂食含维生素C饲料的鱼具有更高的特定生长率，表明维生素C改善了银鲫的生长。
text_zh: 喂食含维生素C饲料的鱼具有更高的特定生长率，表明维生素C改善了银鲫的生长。
text_en: Fish fed vitamin C-supplemented feed had a higher specific growth rate, indicating that vitamin C improved the growth of silver crucian carp.

quote: However, no effect of supplementation with VC was found on the growth of large yellow croaker (Pseudosciaena crocea)
statement: 然而，补充维生素C对大黄鱼（Pseudosciaena crocea）的生长没有影响。
text_zh: 然而，补充维生素C对大黄鱼（Pseudosciaena crocea）的生长没有影响。
text_en: However, vitamin C supplementation had no effect on the growth of large yellow croaker (Pseudosciaena crocea).

quote: The differences in the effects of VC may be related to the fish species and supplemental VC concentration.
statement: 维生素C效果的差异可能与鱼类品种和补充的维生素C浓度有关。
text_zh: 维生素C效果的差异可能与鱼类品种和补充的维生素C浓度有关。
text_en: Differences in the effect of vitamin C may be related to fish species and the concentration of vitamin C supplemented.

quote: Normally, glycemia can be induced by stress in fish
statement: 通常情况下，应激可诱导鱼类血糖升高。
text_zh: 通常情况下，应激可诱导鱼类血糖升高。
text_en: Under normal circumstances, stress can induce elevated blood glucose levels in fish.

quote: Consistent with this, glycemia was induced by hypoxia in gibel carp.
statement: 与此一致，缺氧诱导了银鲫的血糖升高。
text_zh: 与此一致，缺氧诱导了银鲫的血糖升高。
text_en: Consistent with this, hypoxia induced elevated blood glucose in silver crucian carp.

quote: As a metabolite, lactate content increases rapidly under hypoxic conditions
statement: 作为代谢产物，乳酸含量在缺氧条件下迅速增加。
text_zh: 作为代谢产物，乳酸含量在缺氧条件下迅速增加。
text_en: As a metabolic product, lactate content increases rapidly under hypoxic conditions.

statement: 淡水鱼暴露于亚致死浓度的铅后，血液和组织中会出现该金属的显著积累。
text_zh: 淡水鱼暴露于亚致死浓度的铅后，血液和组织中会出现该金属的显著积累。
text_en: After exposure to sublethal concentrations of lead, freshwater fish show significant accumulation of the metal in blood and tissues.

quote:
Synthetic chelating agents are the most commonly
used in the in the treatment of harmful of heavy
metals poisoning [11].
statement: 合成螯合剂是治疗重金属中毒最常用的方法。
text_zh: 合成螯合剂是治疗重金属中毒最常用的方法。
text_en: Synthetic chelating agents are the most commonly used method for treating heavy metal poisoning.

quote: However, the gene expression levels of lc3b and atg5 were significantly downregulated in the VC-diet-fed group, implying that VC attenuated autophagic process induced by hypoxia in gibel carp.
statement: 然而，在VC饲料喂养组中，lc3b和atg5的基因表达水平显著下调，暗示VC减弱了缺氧诱导的鲫鱼自噬过程。
text_zh: 然而，在VC饲料喂养组中，lc3b和atg5的基因表达水平显著下调，暗示VC减弱了缺氧诱导的鲫鱼自噬过程。
text_en: However, in the VC feed group, the gene expression levels of lc3b and atg5 were significantly downregulated, suggesting that VC attenuated hypoxia-induced autophagy in crucian carp.

quote: In the present study, apoptosis was activated by hypoxia, as indicated by increased expression levels of bax and ero1α .
statement: 在本研究中，缺氧激活了细胞凋亡，表现为bax和ero1α表达水平增加。
text_zh: 在本研究中，缺氧激活了细胞凋亡，表现为bax和ero1α表达水平增加。
text_en: In this study, hypoxia activated apoptosis, as indicated by increased expression levels of bax and ero1α.

quote: Increased expression levels of bcl2 , concurrent with inhibited activities of Casp3 and Casp9 together with downregulated casp9 expression induced by VC indicated that VC inhibited apoptosis induced by hypoxia in gibel carp, consistent with results in abalone [ 21 ].
statement: VC诱导的bcl2表达水平增加，同时Casp3和Casp9活性受到抑制以及casp9表达下调，表明VC抑制了缺氧诱导的鲫鱼细胞凋亡，这与鲍鱼的结果一致。
text_zh: VC诱导的bcl2表达水平增加，同时Casp3和Casp9活性受到抑制以及casp9表达下调，表明VC抑制了缺氧诱导的鲫鱼细胞凋亡，这与鲍鱼的结果一致。
text_en: The increased bcl2 expression level induced by VC, along with the inhibition of Casp3 and Casp9 activity and the downregulation of casp9 expression, indicates that VC inhibited hypoxia-induced apoptosis in crucian carp cells, which is consistent with results from abalone.

quote: Additionally, TUNEL-positive cells were significantly reduced in gibel carp fed a VC diet under hypoxia compared with fish in the control group, verifying the anti-apoptosis effects of VC.
statement: 此外，与对照组相比，在缺氧条件下喂食VC饲料的鲫鱼中TUNEL阳性细胞显著减少，证实了VC的抗凋亡作用。
text_zh: 此外，与对照组相比，在缺氧条件下喂食VC饲料的鲫鱼中TUNEL阳性细胞显著减少，证实了VC的抗凋亡作用。
text_en: In addition, compared with the control group, TUNEL-positive cells were significantly reduced in crucian carp fed VC feed under hypoxic conditions, confirming the anti-apoptotic effect of VC.

quote: Taken together, the results suggest that VC enhanced the anti-apoptotic ability of gibel carp through inhibiting ER stress and caspase-dependent pathways.
statement: 综上所述，结果表明VC通过抑制内质网应激和半胱天冬酶依赖性途径增强了鲫鱼的抗凋亡能力。
text_zh: 综上所述，结果表明VC通过抑制内质网应激和半胱天冬酶依赖性途径增强了鲫鱼的抗凋亡能力。
text_en: In summary, the results indicate that VC enhanced the anti-apoptotic capacity of crucian carp by inhibiting endoplasmic reticulum stress and caspase-dependent pathways.

quote: Acute hypoxia stimulates oxidative damage, inflammation, and ER stress, resulting in apoptosis in gibel carp.
statement: 急性缺氧刺激氧化损伤、炎症和内质网应激，导致鲫鱼细胞凋亡。
text_zh: 急性缺氧刺激氧化损伤、炎症和内质网应激，导致鲫鱼细胞凋亡。
text_en: Acute hypoxia stimulates oxidative damage, inflammation and endoplasmic reticulum stress, leading to apoptosis in crucian carp cells.
outcome: 氧化损伤/炎症/内质网应激/细胞凋亡

quote: Throughout the study the average daily oxygen content was 7.2 mg·dm-3, whereas extreme values were 2.8 mg·dm-3 and 12.6 mg·dm-3.
statement: 在整个研究过程中，日均溶解氧含量为7.2 mg·dm-3，极端值为2.8 mg·dm-3和12.6 mg·dm-3。
text_zh: 在整个研究过程中，日均溶解氧含量为7.2 mg·dm-3，极端值为2.8 mg·dm-3和12.6 mg·dm-3。
text_en: Throughout the study, the daily average dissolved oxygen content was 7.2 mg·dm-3, with extreme values of 2.8 mg·dm-3 and 12.6 mg·dm-3.

quote: The morphomicroscopic study of the sections made on the kidneys of experimentally contaminated individuals, highlights a series of changes at the level of the renal parenchyma, but also at the level of the stroma: the renal corpuscle is hypertrophic, with lesions at the glomerular capillaries and enlarged capsular space; peritubular edema (Figure 14), nephrocytic and interstitial necrosis (Figure 15).
statement: 实验污染个体的肾脏显微形态学研究表明，肾实质和间质出现一系列变化，包括肾小体肥大、肾小球毛细血管病变、囊腔扩大、管周水肿以及肾细胞和间质坏死。
text_zh: 实验污染个体的肾脏显微形态学研究表明，肾实质和间质出现一系列变化，包括肾小体肥大、肾小球毛细血管病变、囊腔扩大、管周水肿以及肾细胞和间质坏死。
text_en: Microscopic morphological studies of the kidneys of experimentally contaminated individuals showed a series of changes in the renal parenchyma and interstitium, including glomerular hypertrophy, glomerular capillary lesions, expansion of Bowman's space, peritubular edema, and necrosis of renal cells and interstitium.

quote: The lyophilized coriander succeeds through its active principles to greatly mitigate the toxic effects of the contaminant in the individuals of the LE2 experimental group.
statement: 冻干香菜通过其活性成分成功大幅减轻了LE2实验组个体中污染物的毒性作用。
text_zh: 冻干香菜通过其活性成分成功大幅减轻了LE2实验组个体中污染物的毒性作用。
text_en: Freeze-dried cilantro successfully significantly reduced the toxic effects of pollutants in individuals of the LE2 experimental group through its active components.

quote: The histological preparation obtained from these specimens are showing only slight peritubular edema, capillary hypertrophies (Figure 16).
statement: 从这些样本获得的组织学切片仅显示轻微的管周水肿和毛细血管肥大。
text_zh: 从这些样本获得的组织学切片仅显示轻微的管周水肿和毛细血管肥大。
text_en: Histological sections obtained from these samples showed only mild peritubular edema and capillary hypertrophy.

quote: It is known today that lead is a toxic element that generates oxidative stress.
statement: 目前已知铅是一种产生氧化应激的有毒元素。
text_zh: 目前已知铅是一种产生氧化应激的有毒元素。
text_en: Lead is currently known to be a toxic element that causes oxidative stress.

quote: The optimal piecewise regression model rations were 1.4% of metabolic body weight.
statement: 基于分段回归模型确定的最佳投喂量为代谢体重的1.4%。
text_zh: 基于分段回归模型确定的最佳投喂量为代谢体重的1.4%。
text_en: The optimal feeding rate determined by the segmented regression model is 1.4% of metabolic body weight.
intervention: Segmented regression for optimal feeding rate
intervention_record: 分段回归确定最佳投喂量

quote: High carp mortality has been noted since 2002.
statement: 自2002年以来观察到鲤鱼死亡率较高。
text_zh: 自2002年以来观察到鲤鱼死亡率较高。
text_en: Higher mortality in carp has been observed since 2002.

quote: Bergmann et al. (2006) discovered that the deaths were caused by the Cy-HV3 virus, which causes the disease popularly known as koi herpesvirus (KHV)
statement: Bergmann等人(2006)发现死亡是由Cy-HV3病毒引起的，该病毒导致俗称锦鲤疱疹病毒病(KHV)的疾病。
text_zh: Bergmann等人(2006)发现死亡是由Cy-HV3病毒引起的，该病毒导致俗称锦鲤疱疹病毒病(KHV)的疾病。
text_en: Bergmann et al. (2006) found that mortality was caused by the Cy-HV3 virus, which causes a disease commonly known as koi herpesvirus disease (KHV).

quote: Therefore, the goal of the present study was to determine optimal feed rations for C. carpio × C. auratus hybrid fry (age: 1+) reared in summer in spent cooling water.
statement: 本研究的目标是确定在夏季利用废冷却水养殖鲤鱼×鲫鱼杂交种鱼苗（1+龄）的最佳饲料投喂量。
text_zh: 本研究的目标是确定在夏季利用废冷却水养殖鲤鱼×鲫鱼杂交种鱼苗（1+龄）的最佳饲料投喂量。
text_en: The objective of this study was to determine the optimal feed ration for rearing hybrid carp × crucian carp fingerlings (1+ age) using waste cooling water in summer.

population.system: 网箱养殖，使用电厂废冷却水

quote: The C. carpio × C. auratus hybrid (Fig. 2) rearing material was spring fry of an average mass of 30 g and a total number of 2,250 individuals that were kept in the cages at a density of 150 ind. cage-1.
statement: 养殖材料为平均体重30克的春季鱼苗，总数2250尾，以每笼150尾的密度饲养。
text_zh: 养殖材料为平均体重30克的春季鱼苗，总数2250尾，以每笼150尾的密度饲养。
text_en: The farming material was spring fish fry with an average body weight of 30 grams, totaling 2,250 individuals, reared at a density of 150 per cage.

quote: Facilitating fast fish growth rates when using a relatively small quantity of feed depends on a num-ber of factors directly connected with the applied feeding method.
statement: 使用相对少量的饲料促进鱼类快速生长取决于与所采用的饲喂方法直接相关的多种因素。
text_zh: 使用相对少量的饲料促进鱼类快速生长取决于与所采用的饲喂方法直接相关的多种因素。
text_en: Promoting rapid fish growth with a relatively small amount of feed depends on multiple factors directly related to the feeding method adopted.

quote: Obviously the different feed rations did not meet the nutritional and ener-getic needs of the fish subjected to the experiment to the same degree.
statement: 不同的饲料配给量显然没有同等程度地满足实验鱼类的营养和能量需求。
text_zh: 不同的饲料配给量显然没有同等程度地满足实验鱼类的营养和能量需求。
text_en: Different feed ration levels clearly did not meet the nutritional and energy requirements of the experimental fish to the same extent.

quote: According to the growth rate indica-tors (MGR and SGR), the best results were obtained in variants CC3 and CC4 (Table 4), while the values of these indicators for the other feed rations were lower and significantly different.
statement: 根据生长速度指标（MGR和SGR），CC3和CC4变体获得了最佳结果，而其他饲料配给量的这些指标值较低且存在显著差异。
text_zh: 根据生长速度指标（MGR和SGR），CC3和CC4变体获得了最佳结果，而其他饲料配给量的这些指标值较低且存在显著差异。
text_en: Based on growth rate indicators (MGR and SGR), the CC3 and CC4 variants achieved the best results, while these indicator values were lower for other feed ration levels and showed significant differences.

population.species: Cyprinus carpio L. × Carassius auratus L.

quote: Applying feeds with higher protein and energy contents did not yield better rearing results, but it did increase the cost of the undertaking (Sadowski et al. 2009).
statement: 施用更高蛋白质和能量含量的饲料并未产生更好的养殖结果，但增加了成本。
text_zh: 施用更高蛋白质和能量含量的饲料并未产生更好的养殖结果，但增加了成本。
text_en: Feeding with higher protein and energy content did not produce better farming results, but increased costs.

quote: the best rearing results were obtained when the metabolic feed ration was 1.6% of metabolic mass (Table 4).
statement: 当代谢饲料配给量为代谢体重的1.6%时，获得了最佳的养殖结果。
text_zh: 当代谢饲料配给量为代谢体重的1.6%时，获得了最佳的养殖结果。
text_en: The best farming results were obtained when the metabolic feed ration was 1.6% of metabolic body weight.

population.system: intensely rearing carp in spent cooling water

quote: This study was conducted to investigate the effects of feeding rations on growth, feed utilization, and proximate composition of Cyprinus carpio × Carassius auratus hybrids reared in cages located in power station cooling waters.
statement: 本研究旨在调查投喂量对网箱养殖在电站冷却水中的鲤鱼×鲫鱼杂交种生长、饲料利用率和近似成分的影响。
text_zh: 本研究旨在调查投喂量对网箱养殖在电站冷却水中的鲤鱼×鲫鱼杂交种生长、饲料利用率和近似成分的影响。
text_en: This study aimed to investigate the effects of feeding rate on growth, feed utilization and proximate composition of carp × crucian carp hybrids farmed in cages in power plant cooling water.

population.system: 网箱养殖于电站冷却水

quote: The studies used the carp feed Classic (30.6% protein, 8.8% lipid, 47.5% carbohydrate, and 18.1 MJ kg-1 gross energy) in the following rations: 0.8%, 1.2%, 1.6%, 2.0%, and 2.4% of fish metabolic weight.
statement: 研究使用了经典鲤鱼饲料，投喂量分别为鱼代谢体重的0.8%、1.2%、1.6%、2.0%和2.4%。
text_zh: 研究使用了经典鲤鱼饲料，投喂量分别为鱼代谢体重的0.8%、1.2%、1.6%、2.0%和2.4%。
text_en: The study used classic carp feed, with feeding rates of 0.8%, 1.2%, 1.6%, 2.0% and 2.4% of the fish's metabolic body weight.

population.system: 网箱养殖于电站冷却水

quote: Each of the variants were tested for 140 days in triplicate at a density of 150 fish per cage.
statement: 每个变体以每箱150尾的密度进行了为期140天的三次重复测试。
text_zh: 每个变体以每箱150尾的密度进行了为期140天的三次重复测试。
text_en: Each variant was tested in triplicate for 140 days at a density of 150 fish per box.

population.system: 网箱养殖于电站冷却水

quote: During the experiment, the water temperature ranged from17.1 to 34.3°C, pH was 7.5-9.0, and oxygen was 2.8-12.6 mg dm-3.
statement: 实验期间，水温范围为17.1至34.3°C，pH值为7.5-9.0，溶解氧为2.8-12.6 mg/dm³。
text_zh: 实验期间，水温范围为17.1至34.3°C，pH值为7.5-9.0，溶解氧为2.8-12.6 mg/dm³。
text_en: During the experimental period, water temperature ranged from 17.1 to 34.3°C, pH was 7.5-9.0, and dissolved oxygen was 2.8-12.6 mg/dm³.

population.system: 网箱养殖于电站冷却水

quote:
The average daily pH value dur-
ing the experiment was 7.9, while the extreme values
were 7.5 and 9.0.
statement: 实验期间的日均pH值为7.9，极端值为7.5和9.0。
text_zh: 实验期间的日均pH值为7.9，极端值为7.5和9.0。
text_en: The daily average pH value during the experiment was 7.9, with extreme values of 7.5 and 9.0.

quote:
Taking into account all perfor-
mance indicators, the best rearing results were ob-
tained with the feed ration of 1.6% of metabolic mass
(based mainly on the comparison of FCR and MGR).
statement: 综合考虑所有性能指标，基于FCR和MGR的比较，代谢体重1.6%的投喂量获得了最佳的养殖结果。
text_zh: 综合考虑所有性能指标，基于FCR和MGR的比较，代谢体重1.6%的投喂量获得了最佳的养殖结果。
text_en: Considering all performance indicators, based on the comparison of FCR and MGR, a feed rate of 1.6% of metabolic body weight yielded the best farming results.

quote:
Similar results were obtained from an evaluation
based on a mathematical model, which indicated the
estimated optimal ration was 1.4% of the metabolic
weight.
statement: 基于数学模型的评估得出了类似的结果，表明估计的最佳投喂量为代谢体重的1.4%。
text_zh: 基于数学模型的评估得出了类似的结果，表明估计的最佳投喂量为代谢体重的1.4%。
text_en: Mathematical model-based assessments yielded similar results, indicating that the estimated optimal feeding rate is 1.4% of metabolic body weight.

Only individual fish deaths were noted during
the experiment (11 individuals in total); dead speci-
statement: 实验期间仅观察到个别鱼类死亡（共11条）。
text_zh: 实验期间仅观察到个别鱼类死亡（共11条）。
text_en: During the experiment, only individual fish deaths were observed (11 in total).

statement: 组织病理学检查结果突出了暴露于铅污染的鱼组织的结构和建筑变化。
text_zh: 组织病理学检查结果突出了暴露于铅污染的鱼组织的结构和建筑变化。
text_en: Histopathological examination results highlighted structural and architectural changes in fish tissues exposed to lead contamination.

quote:
coriander has proven to be an excellent chelator
in liver tissue in lead intoxicated fish;
statement: 香菜被证明是铅中毒鱼肝组织中极好的螯合剂。
text_zh: 香菜被证明是铅中毒鱼肝组织中极好的螯合剂。
text_en: Coriander has been proven to be an excellent chelator in the liver tissue of lead-poisoned fish.

quote:
coriander is largely able to attenuate the toxic
effects of lead in kidneys, intestine and gill;
statement: 香菜在很大程度上能够减轻铅在肾脏、肠道和鳃中的毒性作用。
text_zh: 香菜在很大程度上能够减轻铅在肾脏、肠道和鳃中的毒性作用。
text_en: Coriander largely mitigates the toxic effects of lead in the kidneys, intestines, and gills.
