statement: 观察到的极高死亡率表明金鱼幼鱼对CyHV-2感染高度易感，且一旦建立感染可能对病毒复制具有高度容许性。
text_zh: 观察到的极高死亡率表明金鱼幼鱼对CyHV-2感染高度易感，且一旦建立感染可能对病毒复制具有高度容许性。
text_en: The observed extremely high mortality indicates that goldfish juveniles are highly susceptible to CyHV-2 infection and may be highly permissive to viral replication once infection is established.

quote: This experiment also permitted the estimation of susceptibility, revealing that 60% of the population were positive for CyHV-2 (i.e., Luc expression) at 1 dpi, the earliest sampling point, with prevalence increasing to 100% by 3 dpi.
statement: 该实验还允许估计易感性，显示在最早采样点（感染后第1天）有60%的群体对CyHV-2呈阳性（即Luc表达），到感染后第3天时流行率增加到100%。
text_zh: 该实验还允许估计易感性，显示在最早采样点（感染后第1天）有60%的群体对CyHV-2呈阳性（即Luc表达），到感染后第3天时流行率增加到100%。
text_en: The experiment also allowed estimation of susceptibility, showing that at the earliest sampling point (day 1 post-infection), 60% of the population was positive for CyHV-2 (i.e., Luc expression), and by day 3 post-infection, prevalence increased to 100%.

quote: The evolution of Luc expression over time (representing viral load) revealed that time post-infection had a significant impact on viral load (p Figure 3 C, top panel), and was consistent with earlier observations indicating the onset of mortality peak at 3 dpi (Figure 3 B).
statement: Luc表达随时间的演变（代表病毒载量）显示，感染后时间对病毒载量有显著影响，这与早期观察结果一致，即死亡高峰出现在感染后第3天。
text_zh: Luc表达随时间的演变（代表病毒载量）显示，感染后时间对病毒载量有显著影响，这与早期观察结果一致，即死亡高峰出现在感染后第3天。
text_en: The temporal evolution of Luc expression (representing viral load) showed that time post-infection had a significant effect on viral load, consistent with early observations that the peak in mortality occurred on day 3 post-infection.
outcome: 病毒载量与死亡率关系

quote: By this timepoint, we observed that infection had breached the skin barrier and infiltrated other areas of the subject body, leading to the detection of CyHV-2 infected cells within the subcutaneous myotome and cardiac regions (Figure 6 , right panel).
statement: 在感染后第3天，观察到感染突破皮肤屏障并侵入皮下肌节和心脏区域。
text_zh: 在感染后第3天，观察到感染突破皮肤屏障并侵入皮下肌节和心脏区域。
text_en: On day 3 post-infection, infection was observed to breach the skin barrier and invade the subcutaneous myomeres and heart region.

quote: These observations are likely to represent the onset of systemic infection and coincide with the expected onset of mortality peak at 3–5 dpi (Figure 3 B).
statement: 这些观察结果可能代表系统性感染的开始，并与预期的3-5天死亡率高峰相吻合。
text_zh: 这些观察结果可能代表系统性感染的开始，并与预期的3-5天死亡率高峰相吻合。
text_en: These observations may represent the onset of systemic infection and coincide with the expected peak in mortality at 3-5 days.
outcome: 死亡率与感染阶段关联

quote: Curiously, the edge of the cornea seemed to be particularly susceptible to infection.
statement: 角膜边缘似乎特别容易受到感染。
text_zh: 角膜边缘似乎特别容易受到感染。
text_en: The corneal margin appears particularly susceptible to infection.

quote: On this note, given that CyHV-2 was detected in more juvenile subjects and at higher levels at 1 dpi, relative to what was observed in larvae, this may indicate that juveniles are in fact more susceptible than larvae.
statement: 鉴于在感染后第1天，在更多幼鱼个体中检测到CyHV-2且水平高于幼虫中观察到的水平，这可能表明幼鱼实际上比幼虫更易感。
text_zh: 鉴于在感染后第1天，在更多幼鱼个体中检测到CyHV-2且水平高于幼虫中观察到的水平，这可能表明幼鱼实际上比幼虫更易感。
text_en: Given that CyHV-2 was detected in more juvenile fish individuals at a higher level than observed in larvae on day 1 post-infection, this may indicate that juvenile fish are actually more susceptible than larvae.

quote: However, the lack of increase in viral load over time, coupled with the lower mortality, indicates that, overall, relative to larvae, the goldfish juvenile developmental stage may ultimately be less permissive to CyHV-2 replication.
statement: 尽管初期易感，但随时间推移病毒载量未增加且死亡率较低，表明相对于仔鱼，幼鱼阶段对CyHV-2复制的最终容受性可能更低。
text_zh: 尽管初期易感，但随时间推移病毒载量未增加且死亡率较低，表明相对于仔鱼，幼鱼阶段对CyHV-2复制的最终容受性可能更低。
text_en: Although initially susceptible, the viral load did not increase over time and mortality was low, indicating that the final tolerance for CyHV-2 replication may be lower in the juvenile stage compared to the larval stage.

quote: Notably, viral levels in the gut increased at 4 dpi (Figure 7 C, top panel), which was immediately prior to the onset of mortality at 5 dpi (Figure 7 B), but overall time post-infection had no impact on viral load in the gut.
statement: 值得注意的是，肠道中的病毒水平在感染后第4天增加，这紧接着第5天开始出现的死亡，但总体而言，感染后时间对肠道病毒载量没有影响。
text_zh: 值得注意的是，肠道中的病毒水平在感染后第4天增加，这紧接着第5天开始出现的死亡，但总体而言，感染后时间对肠道病毒载量没有影响。
text_en: It is noteworthy that the viral level in the intestine increased on day 4 post-infection, which was immediately followed by mortality starting on day 5, but overall, time post-infection had no effect on intestinal viral load.
outcome: 肠道病毒载量与死亡关联

quote: overall time post-infection had no impact on viral load in the gut
statement: 总体而言，感染后的时间对肠道中的病毒载量没有影响。
text_zh: 总体而言，感染后的时间对肠道中的病毒载量没有影响。
text_en: Overall, time post-infection had no effect on viral load in the gut.

quote: For epifluorescence microscopy analysis of adults (skin and caudal fin), juveniles (eye, gill, skin, and caudal fin), and larvae (whole body), fish were anesthetized as described for IVIS analysis above.
statement: 对于成鱼（皮肤和尾鳍）、幼鱼（眼、鳃、皮肤和尾鳍）和仔鱼（全身）的落射荧光显微镜分析，鱼类按照上述IVIS分析所述方法进行麻醉。
text_zh: 对于成鱼（皮肤和尾鳍）、幼鱼（眼、鳃、皮肤和尾鳍）和仔鱼（全身）的落射荧光显微镜分析，鱼类按照上述IVIS分析所述方法进行麻醉。
text_en: For epifluorescence microscopy analysis of adult fish (skin and caudal fin), juvenile fish (eyes, gills, skin, and caudal fin), and larval fish (whole body), the fish were anesthetized according to the method described for the IVIS analysis above.

quote: This revealed that all stages were susceptible to infection (Figure 3 C, Figure 7 C and Figure 9 C).
statement: 结果显示，所有发育阶段的金鱼均易受感染。
text_zh: 结果显示，所有发育阶段的金鱼均易受感染。
text_en: The results showed that goldfish of all developmental stages were susceptible to infection.

quote: Despite this, larvae were still much more permissive to CyHV-2 replication, exhibiting the greatest increase in viral load over time, ultimately exceeding that of other developmental stages by 4 dpi, leading to much greater mortality (Figure 3 B,C).
statement: 幼鱼对CyHV-2复制更具易感性，病毒载量随时间增加最大，导致死亡率远高于其他发育阶段。
text_zh: 幼鱼对CyHV-2复制更具易感性，病毒载量随时间增加最大，导致死亡率远高于其他发育阶段。
text_en: Juvenile fish are more susceptible to CyHV-2 replication, with the maximum increase in viral load over time leading to a mortality rate far higher than that of other developmental stages.
outcome: 疾病死亡率与病毒复制

quote: Earlier goldfish developmental stages were much more permissive, leading to more mortality, despite being less susceptible to infection.
statement: 早期金鱼发育阶段对病毒复制更具允许性，导致更高的死亡率，尽管它们对感染的易感性较低。
text_zh: 早期金鱼发育阶段对病毒复制更具允许性，导致更高的死亡率，尽管它们对感染的易感性较低。
text_en: Early developmental stages of goldfish are more permissive to viral replication, leading to higher mortality rates, although they have lower susceptibility to infection.
outcome: 疾病死亡率与感染易感性

quote: In contrast to earlier developmental stages, adult goldfish demonstrated remarkably low mortality following challenge with CyHV-2 LucGFP and WT strains by immersion, with an almost 100% survival rate at 30 dpi (Figure 9 B).
statement: 与早期发育阶段相比，成年金鱼经浸泡攻毒CyHV-2后表现出极低的死亡率，在感染后30天几乎达到100%的存活率。
text_zh: 与早期发育阶段相比，成年金鱼经浸泡攻毒CyHV-2后表现出极低的死亡率，在感染后30天几乎达到100%的存活率。
text_en: Compared to early developmental stages, adult goldfish exhibited extremely low mortality after immersion challenge with CyHV-2, reaching almost 100% survival at 30 days post-infection.

quote: While the viral load was lower than the levels observed in the skin of juveniles at 1 dpi, it was higher than the levels observed in larvae at the same time point, indicating that adult goldfish are still relatively susceptible to CyHV-2 infection.
statement: 虽然成年金鱼皮肤中的病毒载量低于幼鱼，但高于同一时间点的仔鱼，表明成年金鱼仍相对易感于CyHV-2感染。
text_zh: 虽然成年金鱼皮肤中的病毒载量低于幼鱼，但高于同一时间点的仔鱼，表明成年金鱼仍相对易感于CyHV-2感染。
text_en: Although the viral load in the skin of adult goldfish was lower than that in juvenile fish, it was higher than that in fry at the same time point, indicating that adult goldfish remain relatively susceptible to CyHV-2 infection.

quote: Others have speculated that in gibel carp, the gut represents a CyHV-2 portal of entry, supporting potential future oral vaccination strategies.
statement: 其他人推测在银鲫中，肠道是CyHV-2的入侵门户，这支持了未来潜在的口服疫苗策略。
text_zh: 其他人推测在银鲫中，肠道是CyHV-2的入侵门户，这支持了未来潜在的口服疫苗策略。
text_en: Others speculated that in gibel carp, the intestine is the portal of entry for CyHV-2, which supports potential future oral vaccination strategies.

quote: Furthermore, mortality commenced at 5 dpi, which is later than in larvae, and continued until approximately 12 dpi, representing a much more gradual rate of mortality compared to larvae (Figure 7 B).
statement: 幼年金鱼的死亡始于感染后第5天，晚于幼鱼，并持续至约第12天，其死亡速率比幼鱼更为平缓。
text_zh: 幼年金鱼的死亡始于感染后第5天，晚于幼鱼，并持续至约第12天，其死亡速率比幼鱼更为平缓。
text_en: Mortality in juvenile goldfish began on day 5 post-infection, later than in fry, and continued until approximately day 12, with a more gradual mortality rate than in fry.

quote: However, unlike in larvae, the viral load in the skin did not increase, with time post-infection having no significant impact on Luc signal.
statement: 与幼鱼不同，幼年金鱼皮肤中的病毒载量没有增加，感染后时间对Luc信号无显著影响。
text_zh: 与幼鱼不同，幼年金鱼皮肤中的病毒载量没有增加，感染后时间对Luc信号无显著影响。
text_en: Unlike juvenile fish, the viral load in the skin of young goldfish did not increase, and time post-infection had no significant effect on Luc signal.
outcome: 皮肤病毒载量随时间变化

quote: However, viral loads were extremely low in the gut, with no virus detected at 1 dpi, and virus detected in a single fish at 2 and 3 dpi.
statement: 然而，肠道中的病毒载量极低，感染后第1天未检测到病毒，第2天和第3天仅在一条鱼中检测到病毒。
text_zh: 然而，肠道中的病毒载量极低，感染后第1天未检测到病毒，第2天和第3天仅在一条鱼中检测到病毒。
text_en: However, the viral load in the gut was very low; no virus was detected on day 1 post-infection, and virus was detected in only one fish on days 2 and 3.

quote: Fig. 5. Quantitative gene expression profiles of MHC I (A) and LYZ C (B) after the challenge with CyHV-2 at 6, 12, 24, 48, and 72 h post-infection using real-time RT-PCR analysis.
statement: 图5展示了在CyHV-2感染后6、12、24、48和72小时，MHC I和LYZ C基因的定量表达谱。
text_zh: 图5展示了在CyHV-2感染后6、12、24、48和72小时，MHC I和LYZ C基因的定量表达谱。
text_en: Figure 5 shows the quantitative expression profiles of MHC I and LYZ C genes at 6, 12, 24, 48, and 72 hours after CyHV-2 infection.

quote: In contrast, while the virus was detected in all juvenile hosts (indicating greater susceptibility) and the viral load was initially higher than in larvae, these levels remained stable over time (Figure 7 C), resulting in reduced mortality in juveniles relative to the larval stage (Figure 7 B).
statement: 虽然幼鱼对所有个体均检测到病毒且初始病毒载量高于幼体，但病毒水平随时间保持稳定，导致其死亡率低于幼体阶段。
text_zh: 虽然幼鱼对所有个体均检测到病毒且初始病毒载量高于幼体，但病毒水平随时间保持稳定，导致其死亡率低于幼体阶段。
text_en: Although viruses were detected in all individual juveniles and the initial viral load was higher than in larvae, virus levels remained stable over time, resulting in lower mortality than during the larval stage.
outcome: 疾病死亡率与病毒复制

quote: Finally, despite similarly high susceptibility, the adult stage was observed to be the least permissive to CyHV-2 replication with a decrease in viral load with respect to time (Figure 9 C), and lower mortality relative to other developmental stages (Figure 9 B).
statement: 尽管成鱼同样具有高易感性，但其对CyHV-2复制的限制性最强，病毒载量随时间下降，且死亡率低于其他发育阶段。
text_zh: 尽管成鱼同样具有高易感性，但其对CyHV-2复制的限制性最强，病毒载量随时间下降，且死亡率低于其他发育阶段。
text_en: Although adults are equally highly susceptible, they show the strongest restriction on CyHV-2 replication, with viral load decreasing over time and mortality lower than in other developmental stages.
outcome: 疾病死亡率与病毒复制

quote: Furthermore, we established through histopathology that, in larvae, this initial infection on the skin was followed by spread to internal organs (Figure 6).
statement: 通过组织病理学证实，在幼鱼中，皮肤上的初始感染随后扩散至内部器官。
text_zh: 通过组织病理学证实，在幼鱼中，皮肤上的初始感染随后扩散至内部器官。
text_en: Histopathological confirmation showed that in juvenile fish, the initial infection on the skin subsequently spread to internal organs.

quote: It revealed that in goldfish (i) earlier developmental stages are less susceptible but more permissive to CyHV-2 infection relative to later developmental stages, ultimately leading to higher mortality in the former,
statement: 研究揭示，在金鱼中，早期发育阶段相对于后期发育阶段对CyHV-2感染的易感性较低但允许性较高，最终导致前者的死亡率更高。
text_zh: 研究揭示，在金鱼中，早期发育阶段相对于后期发育阶段对CyHV-2感染的易感性较低但允许性较高，最终导致前者的死亡率更高。
text_en: The study revealed that in goldfish, the early developmental stage has lower susceptibility but higher permissiveness to CyHV-2 infection compared to the later developmental stage, ultimately resulting in a higher mortality rate in the former.
counterevidence: 早期阶段虽不易感但更允许病毒复制，导致更高死亡率

quote: Mortality was only detected at 72 h post viral challenge.
statement: Mortality was only detected at 72 hours post viral challenge.
text_en: Mortality was only detected at 72 hours post viral challenge.

quote: No further mortality was observed at 168 h post-viral challenge.
statement: No further mortality was observed at 168 hours post-viral challenge.
text_en: No further mortality was observed at 168 hours post-viral challenge.

quote: Despite the lower mortality, challenge by immersion is much more representative of natural infection and had no impact on susceptibility to CyHV-2 among adults or juveniles in this study, which remained at 100%.
statement: 尽管死亡率较低，但浸浴攻击更能代表自然感染，且在本研究中未影响成年或幼鱼对CyHV-2的易感性，其易感性仍为100%。
text_zh: 尽管死亡率较低，但浸浴攻击更能代表自然感染，且在本研究中未影响成年或幼鱼对CyHV-2的易感性，其易感性仍为100%。
text_en: Although mortality was low, immersion challenge better represents natural infection and did not affect the susceptibility of adult or juvenile fish to CyHV-2 in this study; their susceptibility remained 100%.

quote: Interestingly, while viral prevalence was initially lower among larvae, it also increased with respect to time (Figure 3 C).
statement: 有趣的是，虽然幼虫中的病毒流行率最初较低，但随时间推移也增加了。
text_zh: 有趣的是，虽然幼虫中的病毒流行率最初较低，但随时间推移也增加了。
text_en: Interestingly, although the virus prevalence in larvae was initially low, it also increased over time.

quote: Notably, both of these scenarios are consistent with lower susceptibility to CyHV-2 at the larval stage in goldfish.
statement: 值得注意的是，这两种情景都与金鱼幼体阶段对CyHV-2较低的易感性一致。
text_zh: 值得注意的是，这两种情景都与金鱼幼体阶段对CyHV-2较低的易感性一致。
text_en: It is worth noting that both scenarios are consistent with the lower susceptibility of goldfish juveniles to CyHV-2.

quote: In all developmental stages, we observed higher viral load in the skin at 1 dpi, the earliest sampling point post-infection, indicating that the skin represents a highly susceptible and the most permissive organ at early stages of infection after challenge by immersion.
statement: 在所有发育阶段，感染后第1天皮肤中的病毒载量较高，表明皮肤是浸浴攻击后早期感染中最易感和最容许的器官。
text_zh: 在所有发育阶段，感染后第1天皮肤中的病毒载量较高，表明皮肤是浸浴攻击后早期感染中最易感和最容许的器官。
text_en: At all developmental stages, viral loads in the skin were high on day 1 post-infection, indicating that the skin is the most susceptible and permissive organ during early infection after immersion challenge.

quote: Furthermore, in adults and juveniles, the main source of signal in the skin was on the caudal fin, indicating that this region may be more susceptible to infection, and, hence, may act as the main portal of entry at these developmental stages.
statement: 在成鱼和幼鱼中，皮肤信号的主要来源位于尾鳍，表明该区域可能更容易受到感染，并可能在这些发育阶段作为主要的入侵门户。
text_zh: 在成鱼和幼鱼中，皮肤信号的主要来源位于尾鳍，表明该区域可能更容易受到感染，并可能在这些发育阶段作为主要的入侵门户。
text_en: In adult and juvenile fish, the main source of skin signals is located in the caudal fin, indicating that this area may be more susceptible to infection and may serve as a primary portal of entry during these developmental stages.

quote: Since 2011, massive mortality of crucian carp has been observed in many aquatic breeding ponds in northern Jiangsu province, eastern China.
statement: 自2011年以来，在中国东部江苏省北部的许多水产养殖池塘中观察到鲫鱼大量死亡。
text_zh: 自2011年以来，在中国东部江苏省北部的许多水产养殖池塘中观察到鲫鱼大量死亡。
text_en: Since 2011, mass mortality of crucian carp has been observed in many aquaculture ponds in northern Jiangsu Province, eastern China.

quote: Cyprinid herpesvirus 2 (CyHV-2), also known as herpesviral hematopoietic necrosis (HVHNV), was detected and confirmed to be a pathogen (Wang et al., 2012; Wu et al., 2013).
statement: 鲤疱疹病毒2型（CyHV-2），也称为疱疹病毒性造血坏死（HVHNV），被检测并确认为病原体。
text_zh: 鲤疱疹病毒2型（CyHV-2），也称为疱疹病毒性造血坏死（HVHNV），被检测并确认为病原体。
text_en: Cyprinid herpesvirus 2 (CyHV-2), also known as Herpesviral Hematopoietic Necrosis Virus (HVHNV), was detected and confirmed as the pathogen.

quote: The process developed rapidly and the mortality rates reached 90–100% (Xu et al., 2013).
statement: 该过程发展迅速，死亡率高达90-100%。
text_zh: 该过程发展迅速，死亡率高达90-100%。
text_en: The process develops rapidly, with mortality rates as high as 90-100%.

quote: For viral challenges, fish were infected with 1 mL containing 10 6 CyHV-2 particles intraperitoneally, and control groups were infected with 1 mL PBS alone (N = 4 per group).
statement: 实验组鲫鱼通过腹腔注射含有10^6个CyHV-2颗粒的1毫升液体进行感染，对照组仅注射1毫升PBS。
text_zh: 实验组鲫鱼通过腹腔注射含有10^6个CyHV-2颗粒的1毫升液体进行感染，对照组仅注射1毫升PBS。
text_en: The experimental group of crucian carp was infected by intraperitoneal injection of 1 milliliter of liquid containing 10^6 CyHV-2 particles, while the control group was injected with only 1 milliliter of PBS.

quote: The mRNA expression levels of MHC I and LYZ C were measured in the kidney of moribund and survivor fish.
statement: 在濒死和存活的鱼中测量了肾脏中MHC I和LYZ C的mRNA表达水平。
text_zh: 在濒死和存活的鱼中测量了肾脏中MHC I和LYZ C的mRNA表达水平。
text_en: MHC I and LYZ C mRNA expression levels in the kidney were measured in moribund and surviving fish.

quote: In this study, after CyHV-2 infection, MHC I showed the highest up-regula-tion at 72 hpi.
statement: 在本研究中，CyHV-2感染后，MHC I在感染后72小时表现出最高的上调。
text_zh: 在本研究中，CyHV-2感染后，MHC I在感染后72小时表现出最高的上调。
text_en: In this study, after CyHV-2 infection, MHC I showed the highest upregulation at 72 hours post-infection.

quote: These results confirmed that the up-regulation of MHC I and LYZ C could be detected in both acute and chronic infection after CyHV-2 challenge in crucian carp.
statement: 这些结果证实，在鲫鱼受到CyHV-2攻击后的急性和慢性感染中均可检测到MHC I和LYZ C的上调。
text_zh: 这些结果证实，在鲫鱼受到CyHV-2攻击后的急性和慢性感染中均可检测到MHC I和LYZ C的上调。
text_en: These results confirm that upregulation of MHC I and LYZ C can be detected in both acute and chronic infections following CyHV-2 challenge in crucian carp.

quote: The transcript for MHC I was significantly up-regulated at 12 h post-infection (hpi; 2.21-fold, P < 0.05), before declining at 24 and 48 hpi (1.58- and 1.42-fold, respectively, P > 0.05), and finally showing a peak expression level at 72 hpi (5.55-fold, P < 0.01; Fig. 5A).
statement: CyHV-2感染后，MHC I转录本在12小时显著上调，随后在24和48小时下降，并在72小时达到峰值表达水平。
text_zh: CyHV-2感染后，MHC I转录本在12小时显著上调，随后在24和48小时下降，并在72小时达到峰值表达水平。
text_en: After CyHV-2 infection, MHC I transcripts were significantly upregulated at 12 hours, then decreased at 24 and 48 hours, and reached peak expression levels at 72 hours.
outcome: 病毒感染后的免疫应答动态

quote: Our data indicated that these two genes were upregulated after CyHV-2 challenge during both acute and chronic infection.
statement: 数据表明，在急性和慢性感染期间，CyHV-2攻击后这两个基因均上调。
text_zh: 数据表明，在急性和慢性感染期间，CyHV-2攻击后这两个基因均上调。
text_en: Data indicate that both genes were upregulated after CyHV-2 challenge during acute and chronic infection.

quote: Notably, co-exposure to nitrite stress significantly exacerbated mortality in a dose-dependent manner, reducing survival rates to 54.07% and 44.27% at nitrite concentrations of 5 mg/L and 10 mg/L, respectively (Figure 3 A).
statement: 亚硝酸盐胁迫的共暴露以剂量依赖的方式显著加剧了死亡率，在5 mg/L和10 mg/L的亚硝酸盐浓度下，存活率分别降低至54.07%和44.27%。
text_zh: 亚硝酸盐胁迫的共暴露以剂量依赖的方式显著加剧了死亡率，在5 mg/L和10 mg/L的亚硝酸盐浓度下，存活率分别降低至54.07%和44.27%。
text_en: Co-exposure to nitrite stress significantly exacerbated mortality in a dose-dependent manner, with survival rates decreasing to 54.07% and 44.27% at nitrite concentrations of 5 mg/L and 10 mg/L, respectively.

quote: The typical symptoms included varying degrees of hemorrhage (Figure 1 A–C), hepatosplenomegaly (enlargement of liver and spleen), and petechial hemorrhages in the swim bladder (Figure 1 D).
statement: 典型症状包括不同程度的出血、肝脾肿大以及鳔的瘀点状出血。
text_zh: 典型症状包括不同程度的出血、肝脾肿大以及鳔的瘀点状出血。
text_en: Typical symptoms include bleeding of varying degrees, hepatosplenomegaly, and petechial hemorrhage of the swim bladder.

quote: Additionally, the mortal-ity of the lysozyme-treated groups was significantly lower compared to the control group after IPNV infec-tion (Siwicki et al., 1998).
statement: 在IPNV感染后，溶菌酶处理组的死亡率显著低于对照组。
text_zh: 在IPNV感染后，溶菌酶处理组的死亡率显著低于对照组。
text_en: After IPNV infection, the mortality rate in the lysozyme treatment group was significantly lower than that in the control group.

quote: Similar findings were made in blue shrimp Litopenaeus stylirostris, as Lslzm protein increased resistance to WSSV, with infection survival rates reaching 70–80%, compared with infected shrimp injected with PBS alone (Mai and Wang, 2010).
statement: 在蓝对虾中，Lslzm蛋白增加了对WSSV的抵抗力，感染存活率达到70-80%，高于仅注射PBS的感染虾。
text_zh: 在蓝对虾中，Lslzm蛋白增加了对WSSV的抵抗力，感染存活率达到70-80%，高于仅注射PBS的感染虾。
text_en: In Litopenaeus stylirostris, Lslzm protein increased resistance to WSSV, with an infection survival rate of 70-80%, higher than that of infected shrimp injected only with PBS.

quote: Lysozyme also blocked WSSV infection in blue shrimp Litopenaeus stylirostris and modulated the cellular and humoral defense mechanisms after viral infection (Mai and Wang, 2010).
statement: 溶菌酶也阻断了蓝对虾中的WSSV感染，并在病毒感染后调节了细胞和体液防御机制。
text_zh: 溶菌酶也阻断了蓝对虾中的WSSV感染，并在病毒感染后调节了细胞和体液防御机制。
text_en: Lysozyme also blocked WSSV infection in Penaeus stylirostris and regulated cellular and humoral defense mechanisms after viral infection.

quote: Since 2012, a novel viral disease, characterized by lethargy, anorexia, hemorrhage, pale gills, ascites, and splenorenal enlargement, has been identified to be caused by Cyprinid herpesvirus 2 (CyHV-2).
statement: 自2012年以来，一种由鲤疱疹病毒2型（CyHV-2）引起的新型病毒性疾病被鉴定出来，其特征包括嗜睡、厌食、出血、鳃苍白、腹水和脾肾肿大。
text_zh: 自2012年以来，一种由鲤疱疹病毒2型（CyHV-2）引起的新型病毒性疾病被鉴定出来，其特征包括嗜睡、厌食、出血、鳃苍白、腹水和脾肾肿大。
text_en: Since 2012, a novel viral disease caused by Cyprinid herpesvirus 2 (CyHV-2) has been identified, characterized by lethargy, anorexia, hemorrhage, pale gills, ascites, and splenorenal enlargement.

quote: Moreover, CyHV-2 can establish latency and reactivate under stress conditions [ 16 ].
statement: 此外，CyHV-2可以建立潜伏感染并在应激条件下重新激活。
text_zh: 此外，CyHV-2可以建立潜伏感染并在应激条件下重新激活。
text_en: In addition, CyHV-2 can establish latent infection and reactivate under stress conditions.
outcome: 病毒再激活与疾病爆发风险

quote: This study examined CyHV-2 infection in crucian carp under varying nitrite stress levels.
statement: 本研究考察了不同亚硝酸盐胁迫水平下鲫鱼中的CyHV-2感染情况。
text_zh: 本研究考察了不同亚硝酸盐胁迫水平下鲫鱼中的CyHV-2感染情况。
text_en: This study investigated CyHV-2 infection in crucian carp under different levels of nitrite stress.
outcome: 环境胁迫对病毒感染的影响

quote: Hepatic antioxidant capacity and cytokine levels were detected to illustrate systemic inflammation.
statement: 检测肝脏抗氧化能力和细胞因子水平以说明全身性炎症。
text_zh: 检测肝脏抗氧化能力和细胞因子水平以说明全身性炎症。
text_en: Liver antioxidant capacity and cytokine levels were measured to indicate systemic inflammation.

quote: It aimed to understand how environmental stress contributes to viral disease outbreaks and to support strategies, such as stringent nitrite control, to mitigate losses from viral disease in crucian carp aquaculture.
statement: 旨在了解环境胁迫如何导致病毒性疾病爆发，并支持严格亚硝酸盐控制等策略，以减少鲫鱼养殖中病毒性疾病造成的损失。
text_zh: 旨在了解环境胁迫如何导致病毒性疾病爆发，并支持严格亚硝酸盐控制等策略，以减少鲫鱼养殖中病毒性疾病造成的损失。
text_en: Aims to understand how environmental stress leads to viral disease outbreaks, and supports strategies such as strict nitrite control to reduce losses from viral diseases in crucian carp farming.

quote: Two-way ANOVA revealed that both environmental stress and infection duration had extremely significant effects on viral loads (p p p
statement: 双因素方差分析显示，环境应激和感染持续时间对病毒载量均有极显著影响。
text_zh: 双因素方差分析显示，环境应激和感染持续时间对病毒载量均有极显著影响。
text_en: Two-way ANOVA showed that environmental stress and infection duration both had highly significant effects on viral load.

quote: CyHV-2 infection alone induced significant time-dependent oxidative stress.
statement: 单独的CyHV-2感染诱导了显著的时间依赖性氧化应激。
text_zh: 单独的CyHV-2感染诱导了显著的时间依赖性氧化应激。
text_en: CyHV-2 infection alone induced significant time-dependent oxidative stress.

quote: Hepatic MDA content, serving as an indicator of lipid peroxidation, increased rapidly shortly after infection, peaking at 2 dpi, followed by a progressively decline from 3 dpi onward (p Figure 4 A).
statement: 作为脂质过氧化指标的肝脏MDA含量在感染后迅速增加，于第2天达到峰值，随后从第3天起逐渐下降。
text_zh: 作为脂质过氧化指标的肝脏MDA含量在感染后迅速增加，于第2天达到峰值，随后从第3天起逐渐下降。
text_en: Liver MDA content, as an indicator of lipid peroxidation, increased rapidly after infection, peaked on day 2, and then gradually decreased from day 3 onwards.

quote: SOD activity increased slowly, peaking at 2 dpi, and then decreased sharply, reaching its lowest at 5 dpi (p Figure 4 B).
statement: SOD活性缓慢增加，于第2天达到峰值，随后急剧下降，在第5天达到最低点。
text_zh: SOD活性缓慢增加，于第2天达到峰值，随后急剧下降，在第5天达到最低点。
text_en: SOD activity increased slowly, reached a peak on day 2, then decreased sharply, reaching its lowest point on day 5.

quote: CAT activity fluctuated significantly, peaking at 1, 3, and 6 dpi (p Figure 4 C).
statement: CAT活性波动显著，在第1、3和6天达到峰值。
text_zh: CAT活性波动显著，在第1、3和6天达到峰值。
text_en: CAT activity fluctuated significantly, reaching peaks on days 1, 3, and 6.

quote: GPx activity initially decreased, subsequently increased, and then significantly declined once more (p Figure 4 D).
statement: GPx活性最初下降，随后上升，然后再次显著下降。
text_zh: GPx活性最初下降，随后上升，然后再次显著下降。
text_en: GPx activity initially decreased, then increased, and then significantly decreased again.
outcome: 谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶活性

quote: With co-exposure to nitrite, CyHV-2 infection intensified and modified the oxidative stress profile.
statement: 亚硝酸盐与CyHV-2共同暴露加剧了感染并改变了氧化应激谱。
text_zh: 亚硝酸盐与CyHV-2共同暴露加剧了感染并改变了氧化应激谱。
text_en: Co-exposure to nitrite and CyHV-2 exacerbated infection and altered the oxidative stress profile.

quote: Although the overall kinetic pattern of MDA was similar, the group exposed to 10 mg/L nitrite exhibited higher and more sustained MDA peaks during 1–3 dpi, with the lowest MDA level occurring later than in the group exposed to CyHV-2 alone (Figure 4 A).
statement: 尽管MDA的整体动力学模式相似，但暴露于10 mg/L亚硝酸盐的组在感染后1-3天表现出更高且更持续的MDA峰值，且最低MDA水平出现的时间晚于仅暴露于CyHV-2的组。
text_zh: 尽管MDA的整体动力学模式相似，但暴露于10 mg/L亚硝酸盐的组在感染后1-3天表现出更高且更持续的MDA峰值，且最低MDA水平出现的时间晚于仅暴露于CyHV-2的组。
text_en: Although the overall kinetic pattern of MDA was similar, the group exposed to 10 mg/L nitrite showed a higher and more sustained MDA peak at 1-3 days post-infection, and the lowest MDA level occurred later than in the group exposed only to CyHV-2.

quote: Nitrite stress also disrupted the temporal coordination of the antioxidant system.
statement: 亚硝酸盐胁迫还破坏了抗氧化系统的时间协调性。
text_zh: 亚硝酸盐胁迫还破坏了抗氧化系统的时间协调性。
text_en: Nitrite stress also disrupted the temporal coordination of the antioxidant system.

quote: The SOD activity peak occurred earlier under 10 mg/L nitrite stress, followed by a deeper suppression (Figure 4 B).
statement: 在10 mg/L亚硝酸盐胁迫下，SOD活性峰值提前出现，随后受到更深的抑制。
text_zh: 在10 mg/L亚硝酸盐胁迫下，SOD活性峰值提前出现，随后受到更深的抑制。
text_en: Under 10 mg/L nitrite stress, the peak of SOD activity appeared earlier and was subsequently more deeply inhibited.

quote: A sharp decline in CAT activity was specifically observed at 3 dpi in the 10 mg/L nitrite group, coinciding with persistently high MDA levels (Figure 4 C).
statement: 在10 mg/L亚硝酸盐组中，感染后第3天特异性观察到CAT活性急剧下降，这与持续高水平的MDA相吻合。
text_zh: 在10 mg/L亚硝酸盐组中，感染后第3天特异性观察到CAT活性急剧下降，这与持续高水平的MDA相吻合。
text_en: In the 10 mg/L nitrite group, a sharp decrease in CAT activity was specifically observed on day 3 post-infection, which coincided with persistently high levels of MDA.

quote: In contrast, GPx activity was significantly upregulated in the high nitrite group, suggesting a compensatory response specifically targeting peroxide accumulation induced by nitrite exposure (Figure 4 D).
statement: 相比之下，高亚硝酸盐组的GPx活性显著上调，表明这是一种针对亚硝酸盐暴露诱导的过氧化物积累的补偿性反应。
text_zh: 相比之下，高亚硝酸盐组的GPx活性显著上调，表明这是一种针对亚硝酸盐暴露诱导的过氧化物积累的补偿性反应。
text_en: In contrast, GPx activity was significantly upregulated in the high nitrite group, indicating a compensatory response to peroxide accumulation induced by nitrite exposure.
outcome: 谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶活性

quote: The hepatic cytokine response was profoundly influenced by CyHV-2 infection and nitrite exposure (Figure 5).
statement: 肝脏细胞因子反应受到CyHV-2感染和亚硝酸盐暴露的深刻影响。
text_zh: 肝脏细胞因子反应受到CyHV-2感染和亚硝酸盐暴露的深刻影响。
text_en: Hepatic cytokine responses are profoundly affected by CyHV-2 infection and nitrite exposure.

quote: A latency mechanism for CyHV-2 has also been proposed, as viral DNA has been observed to persist in multiple tissues after acute infection, declining by 300 days post-infection, although the virus can be reactivated under temperature stress [ 16 ].
statement: CyHV-2病毒DNA可在急性感染后持续存在于多种组织中，并在温度胁迫下被重新激活。
text_zh: CyHV-2病毒DNA可在急性感染后持续存在于多种组织中，并在温度胁迫下被重新激活。
text_en: CyHV-2 virus DNA can persist in multiple tissues after acute infection and be reactivated under temperature stress.

quote: The potential for other environmental stressors, such as nitrite, to reactivate latent CyHV-2 remains uncertain.
statement: 亚硝酸盐等其他环境胁迫因子重新激活潜伏CyHV-2的潜力尚不确定。
text_zh: 亚硝酸盐等其他环境胁迫因子重新激活潜伏CyHV-2的潜力尚不确定。
text_en: The potential of other environmental stress factors such as nitrite to reactivate latent CyHV-2 is uncertain.

quote: Activation of NF-κB signaling pathway reduced colonization of Edwardsiella piscicida and mortality in zebrafish (Danio rerio) [ 18 ]
statement: NF-κB信号通路的激活减少了斑马鱼中爱德华氏菌的定植和死亡率。
text_zh: NF-κB信号通路的激活减少了斑马鱼中爱德华氏菌的定植和死亡率。
text_en: Activation of the NF-κB signaling pathway reduced Edwardsiella colonization and mortality in zebrafish.

quote: protected Nile tilapia (Oreochromis niloticus) from tilapia lake virus infection [ 19 ]
statement: 保护尼罗罗非鱼免受罗非湖病毒感染。
text_zh: 保护尼罗罗非鱼免受罗非湖病毒感染。
text_en: Protect Nile tilapia from Tilapia lake virus infection.

quote: regulated inflammation in salmonid alphavirus infection in Atlantic salmon (Salmo salar) and rainbow trout (Oncorhynchus mykiss) [ 20 ].
statement: 调节大西洋鲑和虹鳟中鲑鱼甲型病毒感染的炎症反应。
text_zh: 调节大西洋鲑和虹鳟中鲑鱼甲型病毒感染的炎症反应。
text_en: Modulates the inflammatory response to salmonid alphavirus infection in Atlantic salmon and rainbow trout.

population.species: 大西洋鲑 (Salmo salar), 虹鳟 (Oncorhynchus mykiss)

quote: Infectious hematopoietic necrosis virus infection in rainbow trout triggered oxidative stress and upregulated the immune-related genes like nf-κb , tnf-α , il-1β , il-8 , etc. [ 21 ].
statement: 虹鳟传染性造血器官坏死病毒感染引发氧化应激并上调nf-κb等免疫相关基因。
text_zh: 虹鳟传染性造血器官坏死病毒感染引发氧化应激并上调nf-κb等免疫相关基因。
text_en: Infectious hematopoietic necrosis virus infection in rainbow trout induces oxidative stress and upregulates immune-related genes such as NF-κB.

quote: Meanwhile, CyHV-2 had been shown to activate the NF-κB signaling pathway, upregulating proinflammatory genes like il-6 , il-8 , il-1β and tnf-α , causing inflammation [ 22 ].
statement: CyHV-2已被证明能激活NF-κB信号通路，上调促炎基因，导致炎症。
text_zh: CyHV-2已被证明能激活NF-κB信号通路，上调促炎基因，导致炎症。
text_en: CyHV-2 has been shown to activate the NF-κB signaling pathway, upregulate pro-inflammatory genes, and cause inflammation.

quote: Ammonia and nitrite are recognized to inhibit growth, to induce tissue damage, and to elevated mortality rates in fish.
statement: 已知氨和亚硝酸盐会抑制鱼类生长、诱导组织损伤并提高死亡率。
text_zh: 已知氨和亚硝酸盐会抑制鱼类生长、诱导组织损伤并提高死亡率。
text_en: It is known that ammonia and nitrite inhibit fish growth, induce tissue damage, and increase mortality.
outcome: 生长、组织损伤与死亡率

quote: Exposure to these stressors during early life stages can reduce growth and survival rates in rare minnow (Gobiocypris rarus) [ 1 ] and cause tissue damage in various aquatic species, including false clownfish (Amphiprion ocellaris) [ 2 ] and Macrobrachium amazonicum [ 3 ].
statement: 在早期生命阶段暴露于这些压力源会降低稀有鲃的生长和存活率，并在包括双锯鱼属和亚马逊沼虾在内的多种水生动物中引起组织损伤。
text_zh: 在早期生命阶段暴露于这些压力源会降低稀有鲃的生长和存活率，并在包括双锯鱼属和亚马逊沼虾在内的多种水生动物中引起组织损伤。
text_en: Exposure to these stressors during early life stages reduces the growth and survival of rare barbs, and causes tissue damage in a variety of aquatic animals including Amphiprion and Macrobrachium amazonicum.

population.species: rare minnow; false clownfish; Macrobrachium amazonicum

intervention_record: 早期生命阶段压力源暴露
outcome: 生长、存活率与组织健康

quote: Moreover, nitrite exposure caused oxidative stress and immune response in juvenile largemouth bass (Micropterus salmoides) [ 4 ] and silver carp (Hypophthalmichthys molitrix) [ 5 ].
statement: 亚硝酸盐暴露导致大口黑鲈幼鱼和银鱼的氧化应激和免疫反应。
text_zh: 亚硝酸盐暴露导致大口黑鲈幼鱼和银鱼的氧化应激和免疫反应。
text_en: Nitrite exposure causes oxidative stress and immune responses in juvenile largemouth bass and silver fish.

quote: Additionally, these stressors had been associated with inflammatory suppression and immune activation in the head kidney [ 6 ].
statement: 此外，这些压力源与头肾中的炎症抑制和免疫激活有关。
text_zh: 此外，这些压力源与头肾中的炎症抑制和免疫激活有关。
text_en: In addition, these stressors are associated with inflammation suppression and immune activation in the head kidney.

quote: Poor water quality, like high ammonia and nitrite levels, increased viral infection sensitivity in largemouth bass [ 7 ], though the exact mechanism remains poorly understood.
statement: 水质差（如高氨氮和亚硝酸盐水平）增加了大口黑鲈对病毒感染的敏感性，尽管确切机制尚不清楚。
text_zh: 水质差（如高氨氮和亚硝酸盐水平）增加了大口黑鲈对病毒感染的敏感性，尽管确切机制尚不清楚。
text_en: Poor water quality (such as high ammonia nitrogen and nitrite levels) increased the susceptibility of largemouth bass to viral infection, although the exact mechanism is unclear.

quote: Cyprinid herpesvirus 2 (CyHV-2), leading to herpes viral hematopoietic necrosis in crucian carp, causes high mortality and significant economic losses in intensive pond aquaculture.
statement: 鲤科疱疹病毒2型（CyHV-2）导致鲫鱼疱疹病毒性造血坏死，在高密度池塘养殖中造成高死亡率和重大经济损失。
text_zh: 鲤科疱疹病毒2型（CyHV-2）导致鲫鱼疱疹病毒性造血坏死，在高密度池塘养殖中造成高死亡率和重大经济损失。
text_en: Cyprinid herpesvirus 2 (CyHV-2) causes herpetic hematopoietic necrosis in gibel carp, resulting in high mortality and significant economic losses in high-density pond farming.

quote: Throughout the whole experimental period, water temperature was maintained at 24.5 ± 1.0 °C, pH between 7.5 and 7.8, dissolved oxygen ≥ 8 mg/L, and ammonia ≤ 0.2 mg/L.
statement: 在整个实验期间，水温维持在24.5 ± 1.0 °C，pH值在7.5到7.8之间，溶解氧≥8 mg/L，氨氮≤0.2 mg/L。
text_zh: 在整个实验期间，水温维持在24.5 ± 1.0 °C，pH值在7.5到7.8之间，溶解氧≥8 mg/L，氨氮≤0.2 mg/L。
text_en: Throughout the entire experiment, water temperature was maintained at 24.5 ± 1.0 °C, pH between 7.5 and 7.8, dissolved oxygen ≥8 mg/L, and ammonia nitrogen ≤0.2 mg/L.

quote: All infected fish were continuously observed for 6 days post-infection, with mortality record daily.
statement: 所有感染鱼在感染后连续观察6天，并每日记录死亡率。
text_zh: 所有感染鱼在感染后连续观察6天，并每日记录死亡率。
text_en: All infected fish were observed continuously for 6 days post-infection, and mortality was recorded daily.

quote: The liver was chosen to detect antioxidant enzyme activities and cytokines following viral and nitrite stress.
statement: 选择肝脏以检测病毒和亚硝酸盐胁迫后的抗氧化酶活性和细胞因子。
text_zh: 选择肝脏以检测病毒和亚硝酸盐胁迫后的抗氧化酶活性和细胞因子。
text_en: The liver was selected to detect antioxidant enzyme activity and cytokines after viral and nitrite stress.

quote: Protein concentration was measured with a Bradford assay, and the activities of superoxide dismutase (SOD), catalase (CAT), glutathione peroxidase (GPx), and the malondialdehyde (MDA) content were assessed using commercial kits from Nanjing Jiancheng Bioengineering Institute (Nanjing, China).
statement: 使用Bradford法测定蛋白质浓度，并使用南京建成生物工程研究所的商业试剂盒评估超氧化物歧化酶(SOD)、过氧化氢酶(CAT)、谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶(GPx)的活性及丙二醛(MDA)含量。
text_zh: 使用Bradford法测定蛋白质浓度，并使用南京建成生物工程研究所的商业试剂盒评估超氧化物歧化酶(SOD)、过氧化氢酶(CAT)、谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶(GPx)的活性及丙二醛(MDA)含量。
text_en: Protein concentration was determined using the Bradford method, and the activities of superoxide dismutase (SOD), catalase (CAT), and glutathione peroxidase (GPx), as well as malondialdehyde (MDA) content, were assessed using commercial kits from Nanjing Jiancheng Bioengineering Institute.
outcome: 抗氧化能力/脂质过氧化

quote: Intensified pond aquaculture leads to a deterioration in water quality, often leading to disease outbreaks.
statement: 集约化池塘养殖导致水质恶化，常引发疾病爆发。
text_zh: 集约化池塘养殖导致水质恶化，常引发疾病爆发。
text_en: Intensive pond farming leads to water quality deterioration, often triggering disease outbreaks.

quote: Although it is well established that poor water quality exacerbates disease risk, the mechanisms by which environmental stress contributes to disease outbreaks remain unclear.
statement: 虽然已证实水质差会加剧疾病风险，但环境压力导致疾病爆发的机制尚不清楚。
text_zh: 虽然已证实水质差会加剧疾病风险，但环境压力导致疾病爆发的机制尚不清楚。
text_en: Although it has been confirmed that poor water quality exacerbates disease risk, the mechanisms by which environmental stress leads to disease outbreaks remain unclear.

quote: The findings indicated that nitrite exposure caused a dose-dependent decrease in survival rates.
statement: 研究发现亚硝酸盐暴露导致存活率呈剂量依赖性下降。
text_zh: 研究发现亚硝酸盐暴露导致存活率呈剂量依赖性下降。
text_en: The study found that nitrite exposure caused a dose-dependent decrease in survival rate.

quote: This effect may be attributed to nitrite-stress-enhancing, virus-induced hepatic lipid peroxidation, caused premature hyperinflammatory responses, and disrupting anti-inflammatory regulation.
statement: 这种效应可能归因于亚硝酸盐胁迫增强了病毒诱导的肝脏脂质过氧化、过早的过度炎症反应以及抗炎调节的破坏。
text_zh: 这种效应可能归因于亚硝酸盐胁迫增强了病毒诱导的肝脏脂质过氧化、过早的过度炎症反应以及抗炎调节的破坏。
text_en: This effect may be attributed to nitrite stress enhancing virus-induced hepatic lipid peroxidation, premature excessive inflammatory responses, and disruption of anti-inflammatory regulation.

quote: In summary, environmental nitrite stress enhanced viral infections by enhancing oxidative damage, disrupting redox homeostasis, and triggering maladaptive immune responses, thereby accelerating disease progression.
statement: 总之，环境亚硝酸盐胁迫通过增强氧化损伤、破坏氧化还原稳态和触发适应性不良的免疫反应来增强病毒感染，从而加速疾病进展。
text_zh: 总之，环境亚硝酸盐胁迫通过增强氧化损伤、破坏氧化还原稳态和触发适应性不良的免疫反应来增强病毒感染，从而加速疾病进展。
text_en: In summary, environmental nitrite stress enhances viral infection by increasing oxidative damage, disrupting redox homeostasis, and triggering maladaptive immune responses, thereby accelerating disease progression.

quote: The intensification of aquaculture practices has led to a deterioration in water quality, especially in pond culture systems, resulting in the accumulation of harmful ammonia and nitrite levels.
statement: 水产养殖实践的集约化导致水质恶化，特别是在池塘养殖系统中，导致有害氨和亚硝酸盐水平的积累。
text_zh: 水产养殖实践的集约化导致水质恶化，特别是在池塘养殖系统中，导致有害氨和亚硝酸盐水平的积累。
text_en: The intensification of aquaculture practices leads to water quality deterioration, particularly in pond farming systems, resulting in the accumulation of harmful ammonia and nitrite levels.

quote: At 1 dpi, both nitrite-exposed groups displayed significantly higher cytokine levels than the CyHV-2 only group, indicating premature immune activation.
statement: 在感染后第1天，暴露于亚硝酸盐的组别显示出的细胞因子水平显著高于仅感染CyHV-2的组别，表明存在过早的免疫激活。
text_zh: 在感染后第1天，暴露于亚硝酸盐的组别显示出的细胞因子水平显著高于仅感染CyHV-2的组别，表明存在过早的免疫激活。
text_en: On day 1 post-infection, the group exposed to nitrite showed significantly higher cytokine levels than the group infected with CyHV-2 only, indicating premature immune activation.

quote: The 5 mg/L + CyHV-2 group displayed significantly elevated cytokine levels at 4 dpi, whereas the 10 mg/L + CyHV-2 group maintained high levels of IL-8, IFN-γ, and TGF-β at the later stages (5–6 dpi), suggesting a dysregulated and unresolved inflammatory response at the higher nitrite concentration.
statement: 5 mg/L亚硝酸盐加CyHV-2组在第4天显示出显著升高的细胞因子水平，而10 mg/L亚硝酸盐加CyHV-2组在后期（第5-6天）维持高水平的IL-8、IFN-γ和TGF-β，这表明在较高亚硝酸盐浓度下存在失调且未解决的炎症反应。
text_zh: 5 mg/L亚硝酸盐加CyHV-2组在第4天显示出显著升高的细胞因子水平，而10 mg/L亚硝酸盐加CyHV-2组在后期（第5-6天）维持高水平的IL-8、IFN-γ和TGF-β，这表明在较高亚硝酸盐浓度下存在失调且未解决的炎症反应。
text_en: The 5 mg/L nitrite plus CyHV-2 group showed significantly elevated cytokine levels on day 4, while the 10 mg/L nitrite plus CyHV-2 group maintained high levels of IL-8, IFN-γ and TGF-β in the later period (days 5–6), indicating a dysregulated and unresolved inflammatory response at higher nitrite concentrations.

quote: The immune-related gene expression in the kidney was highly modulated by CyHV-2 infection and nitrite stress (Figure 6).
statement: 肾脏中的免疫相关基因表达受到CyHV-2感染和亚硝酸盐胁迫的高度调节。
text_zh: 肾脏中的免疫相关基因表达受到CyHV-2感染和亚硝酸盐胁迫的高度调节。
text_en: The expression of immune-related genes in the kidney is highly regulated by CyHV-2 infection and nitrite stress.

quote: Concurrent exposure to nitrite amplified and altered these transcriptional responses.
statement: 同时暴露于亚硝酸盐会放大并改变这些转录反应。
text_zh: 同时暴露于亚硝酸盐会放大并改变这些转录反应。
text_en: Simultaneous exposure to nitrite amplifies and alters these transcriptional responses.

quote: After two weeks’ acclimation in the round polyvinyl chloride tanks (1000 height mm × 800 mm diameter, with a water volume about 350 L), a total of 256 crucian carps (body weight 300 ± 20 g) were randomly divided into four treatments with four replicates.
statement: 在圆形聚氯乙烯水箱中适应两周后，将256条体重为300±20克的鲫鱼随机分为四个处理组，每组四个重复。
text_zh: 在圆形聚氯乙烯水箱中适应两周后，将256条体重为300±20克的鲫鱼随机分为四个处理组，每组四个重复。
text_en: After a two-week acclimation period in circular polyvinyl chloride tanks, 256 crucian carp weighing 300±20 g were randomly divided into four treatment groups, with four replicates per group.

quote: Sixteen fish were cultured in one tank.
statement: 每个水箱养殖十六条鱼。
text_zh: 每个水箱养殖十六条鱼。
text_en: Sixteen fish are farmed in each tank.

quote: Sodium nitrite was added into the tank to maintain the different nitrite stress.
statement: 向水箱中添加亚硝酸钠以维持不同的亚硝酸盐胁迫水平。
text_zh: 向水箱中添加亚硝酸钠以维持不同的亚硝酸盐胁迫水平。
text_en: Sodium nitrite was added to the water tank to maintain different levels of nitrite stress.

quote: The other three treatments were artificially infected with CyHV-2.
statement: 其他三个处理组进行CyHV-2人工感染。
text_zh: 其他三个处理组进行CyHV-2人工感染。
text_en: The other three treatment groups underwent artificial infection with CyHV-2.

quote: artificial infected with CyHV-2 without nitrite stress (CyHV-2)
statement: 在无亚硝酸盐胁迫下进行CyHV-2人工感染。
text_zh: 在无亚硝酸盐胁迫下进行CyHV-2人工感染。
text_en: Artificial infection with CyHV-2 was conducted under no nitrite stress.

quote: artificial infected with CyHV-2 under 5 mg/L nitrite stress (5 mg/L +CyHV-2)
statement: 在5 mg/L亚硝酸盐胁迫下进行CyHV-2人工感染。
text_zh: 在5 mg/L亚硝酸盐胁迫下进行CyHV-2人工感染。
text_en: Artificial infection with CyHV-2 under 5 mg/L nitrite stress.

quote: and artificial infected with CyHV-2 under 10 mg/L nitrite stress (10 mg/L + CyHV-2).
statement: 在10 mg/L亚硝酸盐胁迫下进行CyHV-2人工感染。
text_zh: 在10 mg/L亚硝酸盐胁迫下进行CyHV-2人工感染。
text_en: CyHV-2 artificial infection was conducted under nitrite stress at 10 mg/L.

quote: During the experimental period, fish were fed with commercial feed twice every day.
statement: 在实验期间，每天两次投喂商业饲料。
text_zh: 在实验期间，每天两次投喂商业饲料。
text_en: During the experiment, commercial feed was provided twice daily.

quote: To investigate the impact of nitrite stress on CyHV-2 infection, a sublethal concentration of 1 × 10 4 copies/mL was selected for injection challenge.
statement: 为了研究亚硝酸盐胁迫对CyHV-2感染的影响，选择了1×10^4拷贝/毫升的亚致死浓度进行注射攻击。
text_zh: 为了研究亚硝酸盐胁迫对CyHV-2感染的影响，选择了1×10^4拷贝/毫升的亚致死浓度进行注射攻击。
text_en: To study the effect of nitrite stress on CyHV-2 infection, a sublethal concentration of 1×10^4 copies/mL was selected for injection challenge.

quote: Cytokines, including tumor necrosis factor α (TNF-α), interleukin 1β (IL-1β), interleukin 8 (IL-8), interferon γ (IFN-γ), transforming growth factor β (TGF-β), and interleukin 10 (IL-10), were measured using the method by Muhammad [ 29 ] with commercial kits from Shanghai Enzyme-linked Biotechnology Co., Ltd. (Shanghai, China).
statement: 细胞因子，包括肿瘤坏死因子α（TNF-α）、白细胞介素1β（IL-1β）、白细胞介素8（IL-8）、干扰素γ（IFN-γ）、转化生长因子β（TGF-β）和白细胞介素10（IL-10），使用Muhammad的方法及上海酶联生物科技有限公司的商业试剂盒进行测量。
text_zh: 细胞因子，包括肿瘤坏死因子α（TNF-α）、白细胞介素1β（IL-1β）、白细胞介素8（IL-8）、干扰素γ（IFN-γ）、转化生长因子β（TGF-β）和白细胞介素10（IL-10），使用Muhammad的方法及上海酶联生物科技有限公司的商业试剂盒进行测量。
text_en: Cytokines, including tumor necrosis factor alpha (TNF-α), interleukin-1 beta (IL-1β), interleukin-8 (IL-8), interferon gamma (IFN-γ), transforming growth factor beta (TGF-β) and interleukin-10 (IL-10), were measured using Muhammad's method and commercial kits from Shanghai Enzyme-linked Biotechnology Co., Ltd.

quote: According to the previous study, 5 mg/L nitrite had no negative effects on juvenile crucian carp [ 27 ].
statement: 根据之前的研究，5 mg/L的亚硝酸盐对幼龄鲫鱼没有负面影响。
text_zh: 根据之前的研究，5 mg/L的亚硝酸盐对幼龄鲫鱼没有负面影响。
text_en: According to previous studies, 5 mg/L of nitrite had no negative effects on juvenile crucian carp.

quote: Based on our pre-experiment, nitrite stress level was set at 5 mg/L and 10 mg/L, respectively.
statement: 基于预实验，亚硝酸盐胁迫水平分别设定为5 mg/L和10 mg/L。
text_zh: 基于预实验，亚硝酸盐胁迫水平分别设定为5 mg/L和10 mg/L。
text_en: Based on preliminary experiments, the nitrite stress levels were set at 5 mg/L and 10 mg/L.
intervention_record: 不同浓度亚硝酸盐暴露

quote: a quarter of the water was regularly changed every 24 h to adjust the nitrite concentration to the initial.
statement: 每24小时定期更换四分之一的水，以将亚硝酸盐浓度调整至初始值。
text_zh: 每24小时定期更换四分之一的水，以将亚硝酸盐浓度调整至初始值。
text_en: Replace one quarter of the water every 24 hours to adjust nitrite concentration to initial values.

quote: During the experiment, water was aerated.
statement: 在实验期间，对水体进行了曝气。
text_zh: 在实验期间，对水体进行了曝气。
text_en: During the experiment, aeration was applied to the water.

quote: In fish challenged solely with CyHV-2, most proinflammatory cytokines (TNF-α, IL-1β, IL-8) (Figure 5 A–C) and IFN-γ (Figure 5 D) exhibited a moderate decrease at 1 dpi, but subsequently maintained elevated levels from 2 to 5 dpi, reaching their peak at 4 or 5 dpi.
statement: 在仅受CyHV-2攻击的鱼中，大多数促炎细胞因子和干扰素-γ在感染后第1天适度下降，但在第2至5天保持高水平，并在第4或5天达到峰值。
text_zh: 在仅受CyHV-2攻击的鱼中，大多数促炎细胞因子和干扰素-γ在感染后第1天适度下降，但在第2至5天保持高水平，并在第4或5天达到峰值。
text_en: In fish challenged with CyHV-2 alone, most pro-inflammatory cytokines and interferon-gamma moderately decreased on day 1 post-infection but remained at high levels from days 2 to 5, peaking on day 4 or 5.

quote: In contrast, the anti-inflammatory cytokine IL-10 showed a declining trend beginning at 2 dpi (Figure 5 F).
statement: 相比之下，抗炎细胞因子IL-10从感染后第2天开始呈下降趋势。
text_zh: 相比之下，抗炎细胞因子IL-10从感染后第2天开始呈下降趋势。
text_en: In contrast, the anti-inflammatory cytokine IL-10 showed a downward trend starting from day 2 post-infection.

quote: In the group subjected to CyHV-2 infection under 5 mg/L nitrite stress, hepatic cytokines (Figure 5 A–E), except for IL-10, exhibited an initial increase at 1 dpi, followed by a decline at 2 dpi, and subsequently rose to reach their peak levels at 4 dpi before decreasing
statement: 在5 mg/L亚硝酸盐胁迫下进行CyHV-2感染的组中，除IL-10外的肝脏细胞因子在第1天初期增加，随后在第2天下降，之后再次上升并在第4天达到峰值后下降。
text_zh: 在5 mg/L亚硝酸盐胁迫下进行CyHV-2感染的组中，除IL-10外的肝脏细胞因子在第1天初期增加，随后在第2天下降，之后再次上升并在第4天达到峰值后下降。
text_en: In the group infected with CyHV-2 under 5 mg/L nitrite stress, liver cytokines other than IL-10 increased initially on day 1, then decreased on day 2, subsequently rose again and reached a peak on day 4 before decreasing.

quote: Hepatic IL-8 and IFN-γ levels varied post-CyHV-2 infection under 10 mg/L nitrite stress, peaking on day 5 dpi
statement: 在10 mg/L亚硝酸盐胁迫下，CyHV-2感染后的肝脏IL-8和IFN-γ水平发生变化，并在感染后第5天达到峰值。
text_zh: 在10 mg/L亚硝酸盐胁迫下，CyHV-2感染后的肝脏IL-8和IFN-γ水平发生变化，并在感染后第5天达到峰值。
text_en: Under 10 mg/L nitrite stress, liver IL-8 and IFN-γ levels changed after CyHV-2 infection and peaked on day 5 post-infection.

quote: Regarding IL-10, a noticeable declining trend was observed following CyHV-2 challenge under both 5 mg/L and 10 mg/L nitrite conditions until 4 dpi, after which levels increased to peak on 5 dpi
statement: 关于IL-10，在5 mg/L和10 mg/L亚硝酸盐条件下进行CyHV-2攻击后，直到第4天观察到明显的下降趋势，之后水平增加并在第5天达到峰值。
text_zh: 关于IL-10，在5 mg/L和10 mg/L亚硝酸盐条件下进行CyHV-2攻击后，直到第4天观察到明显的下降趋势，之后水平增加并在第5天达到峰值。
text_en: Regarding IL-10, after CyHV-2 challenge under nitrite conditions of 5 mg/L and 10 mg/L, a significant downward trend was observed until day 4, after which levels increased and peaked on day 5.

quote: Nonetheless, prior studies have shown that exposure to 5 mg/L nitrite in crucian carp for 30 days [ 27 ] or acute exposure to 10 mg/L nitrite in grass carp (Ctenopharyngodon idella) [ 35 ] does not cause mortality.
statement: 尽管如此，先前的研究表明，鲫鱼暴露于5毫克/升亚硝酸盐30天或草鱼急性暴露于10毫克/升亚硝酸盐不会导致死亡。
text_zh: 尽管如此，先前的研究表明，鲫鱼暴露于5毫克/升亚硝酸盐30天或草鱼急性暴露于10毫克/升亚硝酸盐不会导致死亡。
text_en: Nevertheless, previous studies have shown that exposure of crucian carp to 5 mg/L nitrite for 30 days or acute exposure of grass carp to 10 mg/L nitrite did not result in mortality.

quote: This suggests that the decreased survival observed in our co-exposure groups is likely attributable to synergistic mechanisms, rather than nitrite toxicity alone, although an additive effect cannot be entirely ruled out.
statement: The authors suggest that decreased survival in co-exposure groups is likely due to synergistic mechanisms between nitrite and the virus, rather than nitrite toxicity alone.
text_en: The authors suggest that decreased survival in co-exposure groups is likely due to synergistic mechanisms between nitrite and the virus, rather than nitrite toxicity alone.
limitations: additive effect cannot be entirely ruled out

quote: Furthermore, without histopathological examination, the structural correlates of the observed organ dysfunction remain uncharacterized.
statement: Without histopathological examination, the structural causes of observed organ dysfunction are not characterized.
text_en: Without histopathological examination, the structural causes of observed organ dysfunction are not characterized.

quote: Future studies should incorporate detailed histopathological assessments to further elucidate these findings.
statement: Future studies should use detailed histopathological assessments to clarify the findings.
text_en: Future studies should use detailed histopathological assessments to clarify the findings.

quote: The observation that the viral load speak (3–4 dpi) preceded the peak mortality (4–5 dpi), suggested that host mortality is more likely a consequence of immunopathological damage and tissue injury following peak viremia, rather than solely due to the initial viral replication.
statement: Viral load peaking before mortality suggests that death is likely caused by immunopathological damage and tissue injury after peak viremia, rather than just initial viral replication.
text_en: Viral load peaking before mortality suggests that death is likely caused by immunopathological damage and tissue injury after peak viremia, rather than just initial viral replication.

quote: In CyHV-3 infected carp at 22 °C, virus expression was abundant and correlated with tissue damage, clinical disease, and mortality [ 36 ].
statement: In carp infected with CyHV-3 at 22°C, abundant virus expression correlated with tissue damage, clinical disease, and mortality.
text_en: In carp infected with CyHV-3 at 22°C, abundant virus expression correlated with tissue damage, clinical disease, and mortality.

quote: In farmed Atlantic salmon, rapid viral replication led to extensive cellular damage before the host’s immune system could develop an effective response [ 38 ].
statement: In farmed Atlantic salmon, rapid viral replication caused extensive cellular damage before the host's immune system could respond effectively.
text_en: In farmed Atlantic salmon, rapid viral replication caused extensive cellular damage before the host's immune system could respond effectively.

quote: Notably, survival rates were further reduced to 54.07% and 44.27% at 5 and 10 mg/L nitrite levels, respectively.
statement: 值得注意的是，在5和10 mg/L的亚硝酸盐水平下，存活率分别进一步降低至54.07%和44.27%。
text_zh: 值得注意的是，在5和10 mg/L的亚硝酸盐水平下，存活率分别进一步降低至54.07%和44.27%。
text_en: It is worth noting that at nitrite levels of 5 and 10 mg/L, survival rates further decreased to 54.07% and 44.27%, respectively.

quote: These survival rates were significantly lower than those in the virus-only group, indicating a dose-dependent relationship between increased nitrite concentration and accelerated disease outbreak.
statement: 这些存活率显著低于仅病毒组，表明亚硝酸盐浓度增加与疾病爆发加速之间存在剂量依赖性关系。
text_zh: 这些存活率显著低于仅病毒组，表明亚硝酸盐浓度增加与疾病爆发加速之间存在剂量依赖性关系。
text_en: These survival rates were significantly lower than the virus-only group, indicating a dose-dependent relationship between increased nitrite concentration and accelerated disease outbreaks.

quote: This finding underscores that environmental stress is a critical modulator of disease outcomes, aligning with previous research on juvenile largemouth bass, which found nitrate concentrations related with mortality of virus and the viral load [ 7 ].
statement: 这一发现强调环境压力是疾病结果的关键调节因素，这与之前关于大口黑鲷幼鱼的研究一致，该研究发现硝酸盐浓度与病毒死亡率及病毒载量相关。
text_zh: 这一发现强调环境压力是疾病结果的关键调节因素，这与之前关于大口黑鲷幼鱼的研究一致，该研究发现硝酸盐浓度与病毒死亡率及病毒载量相关。
text_en: This finding highlights that environmental stress is a key modulator of disease outcomes, consistent with previous research on juvenile largemouth bass, which found that nitrate concentration was correlated with viral mortality and viral load.

quote: Additionally, ammonia nitrogen accumulation increased susceptibility of Litopenaeus vannamei to Vibrio parahaemolyticus [ 31 ].
statement: 此外，氨氮积累增加了凡纳滨对虾对副溶血弧菌的易感性。
text_zh: 此外，氨氮积累增加了凡纳滨对虾对副溶血弧菌的易感性。
text_en: In addition, ammonia nitrogen accumulation increased the susceptibility of Litopenaeus vannamei to Vibrio parahaemolyticus.

quote: As ectothermic vertebrates, fish are very sensitive to environmental changes, particularly during pathogen infections [ 32 ].
statement: 作为变温脊椎动物，鱼类对环境变化非常敏感，尤其是在病原体感染期间。
text_zh: 作为变温脊椎动物，鱼类对环境变化非常敏感，尤其是在病原体感染期间。
text_en: As ectothermic vertebrates, fish are very sensitive to environmental changes, especially during pathogen infection.

quote: Acute nitrite exposure would proliferate pathogenic Photobacterium and drive mortality in Pacific white shrimp (Penaeus vannamei) [ 34 ].
statement: 急性亚硝酸盐暴露会增殖致病性发光杆菌并导致太平洋白虾（凡纳滨对虾）死亡。
text_zh: 急性亚硝酸盐暴露会增殖致病性发光杆菌并导致太平洋白虾（凡纳滨对虾）死亡。
text_en: Acute nitrite exposure proliferates pathogenic Vibrio harveyi and causes mortality in Pacific white shrimp (Litopenaeus vannamei).

quote: it complicates the disentanglement of nitrite’s direct effects from its interactions with the virus.
statement: 这使得难以区分亚硝酸盐的直接效应与其与病毒的相互作用。
text_zh: 这使得难以区分亚硝酸盐的直接效应与其与病毒的相互作用。
text_en: This makes it difficult to distinguish the direct effects of nitrite from its interactions with viruses.
intervention_record: 缺乏亚硝酸盐单独对照

quote: Specifically, nitrite stress enhanced the activation of proinflammatory genes and those in the NF-κB pathway (Figure 6 A–C).
statement: 具体来说，亚硝酸盐胁迫增强了促炎基因和NF-κB通路中基因的激活。
text_zh: 具体来说，亚硝酸盐胁迫增强了促炎基因和NF-κB通路中基因的激活。
text_en: Specifically, nitrite stress enhanced the activation of pro-inflammatory genes and genes in the NF-κB pathway.

quote: The expression levels of tlr5 (at 3 dpi) and nf-κb (at 2 and 4 dpi) were elevated higher in nitrite-exposed groups than to those infected with CyHV-2 alone.
statement: 与仅感染CyHV-2的组相比，亚硝酸盐暴露组的tlr5（在3 dpi）和nf-κb（在2和4 dpi）的表达水平更高。
text_zh: 与仅感染CyHV-2的组相比，亚硝酸盐暴露组的tlr5（在3 dpi）和nf-κb（在2和4 dpi）的表达水平更高。
text_en: Compared to the group infected with CyHV-2 only, the expression levels of tlr5 (at 3 dpi) and nf-κb (at 2 and 4 dpi) were higher in the nitrite exposure group.

quote: Concurrently, the suppression of iκκb was significantly intensified, particularly at 3 dpi in the 10 mg/L group, suggesting impaired negative feedback on NF-κB signaling pathway.
statement: 同时，iκκb的抑制显著加剧，特别是在10 mg/L组的3 dpi，表明对NF-κB信号通路的负反馈受损。
text_zh: 同时，iκκb的抑制显著加剧，特别是在10 mg/L组的3 dpi，表明对NF-κB信号通路的负反馈受损。
text_en: At the same time, inhibition of iκκb was significantly exacerbated, especially in the 10 mg/L group at 3 dpi, indicating impaired negative feedback on the NF-κB signaling pathway.

quote: Specifically, the relative expression of il-1β was remarkably upregulated under nitrite stress at 2–4 dpi.
statement: 具体来说，在2-4 dpi期间，亚硝酸盐胁迫下il-1β的相对表达量显著上调。
text_zh: 具体来说，在2-4 dpi期间，亚硝酸盐胁迫下il-1β的相对表达量显著上调。
text_en: Specifically, during the period of 2-4 dpi, the relative expression of il-1β was significantly upregulated under nitrite stress.

quote: In contrast, il-8 expression was further amplified by nitrite exposure at 4 dpi.
statement: 相比之下，在4 dpi时，亚硝酸盐暴露进一步放大了il-8的表达。
text_zh: 相比之下，在4 dpi时，亚硝酸盐暴露进一步放大了il-8的表达。
text_en: In contrast, at 4 dpi, nitrite exposure further amplified il-8 expression.

quote: Meanwhile, ifn-γ expression was initially suppressed during the mid-phase of infection, followed by a compensatory increase in the 10 mg/L group at later stage (4–5 dpi).
statement: 与此同时，ifn-γ表达在感染中期最初受到抑制，随后在后期（4-5 dpi）10 mg/L组中出现补偿性增加。
text_zh: 与此同时，ifn-γ表达在感染中期最初受到抑制，随后在后期（4-5 dpi）10 mg/L组中出现补偿性增加。
text_en: Meanwhile, ifn-γ expression was initially suppressed during the mid-infection stage, followed by a compensatory increase in the late stage (4-5 dpi) in the 10 mg/L group.

quote: Notably, CyHV-2, like many herpesviruses, can enter a latent state and reactivated under stress conditions [ 16 ].
statement: CyHV-2病毒可以进入潜伏状态，并在应激条件下重新激活。
text_zh: CyHV-2病毒可以进入潜伏状态，并在应激条件下重新激活。
text_en: CyHV-2 virus can enter a latent state and reactivate under stress conditions.

quote: In the context of our findings, nitrite-induced oxidative stress and NF-κB hyperactivation may create a permissive environment for viral reactivation.
statement: 亚硝酸盐诱导的氧化应激和NF-κB过度激活可能为病毒再激活创造有利环境。
text_zh: 亚硝酸盐诱导的氧化应激和NF-κB过度激活可能为病毒再激活创造有利环境。
text_en: Nitrite-induced oxidative stress and excessive NF-κB activation may create a favorable environment for viral reactivation.

quote: The marked suppression of iκκβ, a negative regulator of NF-κB, under conditions of high nitrite exposure, suggested impaired feedback control, potentially facilitating viral reactivation.
statement: 在高亚硝酸盐暴露条件下，作为NF-κB负调控因子的iκκβ受到显著抑制，表明反馈控制受损，这可能促进病毒再激活。
text_zh: 在高亚硝酸盐暴露条件下，作为NF-κB负调控因子的iκκβ受到显著抑制，表明反馈控制受损，这可能促进病毒再激活。
text_en: Under high nitrite exposure conditions, IκKβ, a negative regulator of NF-κB, was significantly inhibited, indicating impaired feedback control, which may promote viral reactivation.

quote: Although the present study did not directly assess latent virus reactivation, the immunological and oxidative disturbances observed are aligned with mechanisms known to trigger herpesvirus reactivation [ 17 ].
statement: 虽然本研究未直接评估潜伏病毒的再激活，但观察到的免疫和氧化扰动与已知触发疱疹病毒再激活的机制一致。
text_zh: 虽然本研究未直接评估潜伏病毒的再激活，但观察到的免疫和氧化扰动与已知触发疱疹病毒再激活的机制一致。
text_en: Although this study did not directly assess the reactivation of latent viruses, the observed immune and oxidative disturbances are consistent with known mechanisms that trigger herpesvirus reactivation.
limitations: 未直接评估潜伏病毒再激活

quote: Future studies should investigate how nitrite stress may reactivate latent CyHV-2 in recovered or subclinical infected fish, which would further elucidate the environmental drivers of CyHV-2 outbreaks in aquaculture settings.
statement: 未来的研究应调查亚硝酸盐应激如何可能在康复或亚临床感染的鱼中重新激活潜伏的CyHV-2，这将进一步阐明水产养殖环境中CyHV-2爆发的环境驱动因素。
text_zh: 未来的研究应调查亚硝酸盐应激如何可能在康复或亚临床感染的鱼中重新激活潜伏的CyHV-2，这将进一步阐明水产养殖环境中CyHV-2爆发的环境驱动因素。
text_en: Future research should investigate how nitrite stress may reactivate latent CyHV-2 in recovering or subclinically infected fish, which would further elucidate the environmental drivers of CyHV-2 outbreaks in aquaculture settings.

quote: The renal transcriptional activation of inflammatory genes observed in this study suggested possible structural or functional impairments induced by CyHV-2 infection.
statement: 本研究中观察到的肾脏炎症基因的转录激活表明CyHV-2感染可能引起结构或功能损伤。
text_zh: 本研究中观察到的肾脏炎症基因的转录激活表明CyHV-2感染可能引起结构或功能损伤。
text_en: The transcriptional activation of kidney inflammation genes observed in this study suggests that CyHV-2 infection may cause structural or functional damage.

quote: Nitrite, as an oxidative stressor, may further aggravate osmoregulatory dysfunction.
statement: 亚硝酸盐作为一种氧化应激源，可能会进一步加重渗透压调节功能障碍。
text_zh: 亚硝酸盐作为一种氧化应激源，可能会进一步加重渗透压调节功能障碍。
text_en: Nitrite, as a source of oxidative stress, may further exacerbate osmoregulatory dysfunction.

quote: An interesting finding in our study was the significant reduction in viral load under nitrite stress, despite a concurrent increase in mortality.
statement: 本研究发现，在亚硝酸盐胁迫下病毒载量显著降低，但死亡率同时增加。
text_zh: 本研究发现，在亚硝酸盐胁迫下病毒载量显著降低，但死亡率同时增加。
text_en: This study found that under nitrite stress, viral load significantly decreased, but mortality increased at the same time.
outcome: 疾病严重程度与死亡率

quote: It meant that a low viral load did not necessarily correlate with a mild disease outcome.
statement: 这意味着低病毒载量并不一定与轻微的病情结果相关。
text_zh: 这意味着低病毒载量并不一定与轻微的病情结果相关。
text_en: This means that a low viral load does not necessarily correlate with mild disease outcomes.
outcome: 疾病严重程度评估指标

quote: We hypothesize that under the combined stressors of nitrite exposure and virus infection, the fish immune system became overloaded, resulting in a lower threshold for viral impact compared to normal status.
statement: 我们假设在亚硝酸盐暴露和病毒感染的复合胁迫下，鱼类免疫系统过载，导致病毒影响的阈值低于正常状态。
text_zh: 我们假设在亚硝酸盐暴露和病毒感染的复合胁迫下，鱼类免疫系统过载，导致病毒影响的阈值低于正常状态。
text_en: We hypothesize that under the combined stress of nitrite exposure and viral infection, the fish immune system is overloaded, resulting in a lower threshold for viral impact compared to normal conditions.

quote: That was to say, under environmental stress, a viral load that would typically cause morbidity may instead lead to mortality in fish.
statement: 也就是说，在环境胁迫下，通常会导致发病的病毒载量可能会导致鱼类死亡。
text_zh: 也就是说，在环境胁迫下，通常会导致发病的病毒载量可能会导致鱼类死亡。
text_en: In other words, under environmental stress, viral loads that would typically cause disease may lead to fish mortality.

quote: Nitrite stress has been shown to cause gill damage and impair osmoregulatory and respiratory functions, as documented in grass carp [ 35 ], false clownfish (Amphiprion ocellaris) [ 2 ], and yellow catfish (Pelteobagrus fulvidraco) [ 39 ].
statement: 已有文献记录表明，亚硝酸盐胁迫会导致鳃损伤并损害渗透压调节和呼吸功能。
text_zh: 已有文献记录表明，亚硝酸盐胁迫会导致鳃损伤并损害渗透压调节和呼吸功能。
text_en: Existing literature records indicate that nitrite stress causes gill damage and impairs osmoregulation and respiratory function.

population.species: 草鱼; 双锯鱼; 黄颡鱼

outcome: 生理机能（鳃、渗透压、呼吸）

quote: This study demonstrated that CyHV-2 infection elicited significant time-dependent oxidative stress in the liver, characterized by an early peak in lipid peroxidation, as indicated by MDA levels, followed by a dysregulated antioxidant enzyme response.
statement: 本研究证明CyHV-2感染在肝脏中引发了显著的时间依赖性氧化应激，其特征是脂质过氧化早期峰值（由MDA水平指示），随后出现抗氧化酶反应失调。
text_zh: 本研究证明CyHV-2感染在肝脏中引发了显著的时间依赖性氧化应激，其特征是脂质过氧化早期峰值（由MDA水平指示），随后出现抗氧化酶反应失调。
text_en: This study demonstrated that CyHV-2 infection induced significant time-dependent oxidative stress in the liver, characterized by an early peak of lipid peroxidation (indicated by MDA levels), followed by dysregulation of antioxidant enzyme responses.
